verses.text: U Aleksander uba na Masedonia, u khun jong u Philip, u la wan na ka ri Kittim bad u la jop ïa u Darius, u syiem jong ki Persha bad ki Mid, kumta u sa long syiem artat ha ka jaka jong u. (Mynshuwa u la long u syiem jong ka ri Gris).
U la ïaleh bun ki thma, u la jop bun ki kut, bad u la pynïap ïa ki syiem jong ki muluk ba u la jop.
U la tur shaduh bakut ka pyrthei, bad u la kurup ïa ki jait bynriew naphang. Ynda ka pyrthei ka la kynjah jak hakhmat jong u, u la sngewmeng ha la ka dohnud.
U la lum ka kynhun shipai ka bakhlaiñ shibun, bad u la synshar halor bun ki ri, ki jait bynriew, bad ki syiem, bad kine ki la siew khajna ha u.
Hadien kane u la kem pang bad u la ïohi ba un sa ïap.
Kumta u la khot lang ïa ki rangbah pyrton ki bapawkhmat eh, kiba la ïasan ïarangbah lang bad u naduh dang samla, bad u la ïasam ïa ka hima jong u hapdeng jong ki katba u dang im.
U Aleksander u la synshar khat-ar snem bad u la ïap.
Te kine ki rangbah pyrton jong u ki la sdang ban synshar, uwei pa uwei ha la ka jaka jaka.

Baroh kine ki la shim ïa ka pansngiat syiem hadien ka jingïap jong u, bad ki khun shynrang jong ki ruh ki la leh kumjuh hadien jong ki, bun bun snem. Te ki la wan rah shibun ki jingjynjar ha ka pyrthei.

Na ki la mih u symbai briew u bajakhlia, u Antiokhus Epiphanes, u khun jong u syiem Antiokhus; shisien une u la shah set koidi jamin ha Rome. U la sdang ban synshar ha ka snem 137 jong ka hima ki Grik [175 SK].

Ha kito ki por la mih na Israel ki kynja briew kiba leh be-aiñ, bad kine ki la ïalam bakla bun ki briew, ki ong, “Ïa ngin ïateh jutang bad ki Jentil kiba shong sawdong jong ngi, namarba ngi la ngat ha ki jingjynjar shikatdei naduh ba ngi pynkyrpang ïa lade na ki.”
Kane ka jingai jingmut ka la pynsngewbha ïa ki,
bad la don na ki paidbah kiba la sngewkmen shibun ban leit ïakynduh ïa u syiem. Une u la ai bor ïa ki ban rakhe ïa ki dustur jong ki Jentil.
Kumta ki la tei ka kynja lympung ïalehkai ha Jerusalem, katkum ka dustur Jentil,
ki la buhrieh ïa ki dak jingotsher, bad ki la kyntait ïa ka jutang bakhuid. Ki la ïateh lok bad ki Jentil bad ki la die ïa lade ban leh bymman.
Haba u Antiokhus u la ïohi ba ka hima jong u ka la skhem, u la kut jingmut ban long syiem sa ïa ka ri Ijipt ruh, ba un dup ïoh synshar ïa ki hima baroh ar.
Kumta u la hiar thma ïa ka Ijipt da ka bor bah, da ki kali, da ki hati, da ki pyrton kulai bad da ki lieng ïapom shikatdei.
U la ïaleh thma ïa u Ptolemi u syiem Ijipt, bad u Ptolemi u la phet da ka jingtieng nakhmat jong u, u da ieh noh bun bah ki bamynsaw bad ki baïap.
Hangta ki la ïoh knieh ïa ki shnong kiba la tei kut ha ri Ijipt, bad ki la knieh ïa ka ri Ijipt.
Ynda la pyndem ïa ka Ijipt, u Antiokhus u la wan phai ha ka snem 143 [169 SK]. U la leit ïaleh sa ïa ki Israel bad u la poi haduh Jerusalem bad ka kynhun shipai ka bakhlaiñ.
Da ka jinghangamei u la rung hapoh ka jaka kyntang, bad u la shim ïa ka duwan ksiar, ïa ka jynpynïeng sharak lem bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh phoiñ.

U la shim ruh ïa ka miej u ’pukyntang, ïa ki khuri ki jingtyrwa jyndih, ïa ki dabor, ïa ki jynrah dhup kiba da ka ksiar, ïa ka pyrda, ïa ki pansngiat bad ïa ki shrong pynitynnat kiba nakhmat ka tempyl; u la slied lyngkhuit phoiñ ïa ka.
U la rong ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar, bad ïa ki khiew ki pliang ki bakordor; u la rah bak wat ïa ka spah ka hajar kaba u la lap ha ka jaka buhrieh.
Ynda u la shim ïa kine baroh, u la leit phai sha la ka ri. U la leh ki kam pynïap briew, bad u la kren meng haduh katta katta.
Ki Israel ki la ïam sngewsih ha man ki kyntoit shnong baroh.
Ki nongsynshar bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ud, ki samla kynthei bad ki samla shynrang ki la pait dohnud, ki ’theibhabriew ki la kylla dur.
Man la u nongleitkurim u la kren pangnud; ka nongleitkurim ka shu khñi ïam ha la kamra.
Wat ka ri ka la kyïuh na ka bynta ki trai shnong jong ka, ïa ka ïing jong u Jakob baroh kawei la tap da ka jinglehraiñ.
Ar snem hadien, une u syiem u la phah u rangbah nonglum khajna sha ki shong Judea, bad u la wan poi ha Jerusalem lem bad ka kynhun shipai ka bakhraw.
Da ki ktien thok suda u la kren suk kren saiñ ïa ki, bad ki la ngeit ïa u, hynrei kynsan kynsan u la hiar ngak halor ka nongbah, u la ther tyngeh ïa ka, bad u la pynïap bun bah ki paid Israel.
U la knieh ïa ka nongbah, u la thang ïa ka da ka ding, bad u la pyntwa ïa ki ïing ki sem jong ka, wat ïa ki kynroh kiba ker sawdong ïa ka.
Ki la ring mraw ïa ki kynthei bad ïa ki khynnah, bad ki la rong noh ïa ki jynri jyndup.
Hadien kata ki la pynkhlaiñ ïa ka nongbah u Dabid da ka kynroh ka bakynjang bad ka baskhem triang, bad da ki kut thma ki ba khlaiñ, te kumta ka la kylla long ka kutbah jong ki.
Ki la pynshong hangta tang da ki ’riewjakhlia suda bad da ki ’riewbe-aiñ. Kine ki la pynkhlaiñ ïa lade hangta.
Ki la taïar ki tiar thma bad ka jynbam, bad ynda ki la buh lang hangta ïa ki bai kliarwait kiba ki la khur lut na Jerusalem, ki la long ka jingma ka bakhraw.
Ka la long ka jingap ktem pyrshah ka ïing bakhuid, u dusmon bymman ïa ka Israel baroh shilynter.
Sawdong ka ïing bakhuid ki la pynphlei snam ïa ki balui lui; ki la pynbyrsieh wat ïa ka ïing bakhuid.
Namar jong ki ki nong Jerusalem ki la phet ïap; ka nongbah ka la kylla long ka jaka shong ki mynder, ka la kylla nongwei ïa la ki khun, ki khun ki kti lajong ki la ieh noh lyndet ïa ka.
Ka ïing bakhuid jong ka ka la kynjah kum ka ri shyiap; ki jingkhawai niam jong ka ki la kylla ki jingïam bynñiaw, ki sabath jong ka ki shah kynshi, ka burom jong ka ka shah ibeiñ.
Ka jingjah burom jong ka ka la khraw kat ka nam jong ka, ka jingkhraw nam jong ka ka la kylla ka jingïam briew.
Te u syiem u la thoh sha ka hima baroh kawei ba ki briew baroh ki dei ban long tang uwei u paid,
bad ba uwei pa uwei u dei ban ieh noh noh ïa la ki dustur.
Ki Jentil baroh ki la pdiang ïa kata ka hukum u syiem. Wat na ki Israel bun ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa ka niam jong u; ki la kñia ha ki blei thaw bad ki la leh sang ïa ka sabath.
U syiem u la phah shithi da ki nongrah khubor sha Jerusalem bad sha ki shnong Judea; u la pynmih hukum ba dei ban bud ïa ki dustur kibym ju don ha ka ri,
da kaba adong ïa ki jingtyrwa thang, ïa ki jingkñia bad ïa ki jingtyrwa jyndih ha ka ïing bakhuid, da kaba pynkheiñ ïa ki sabath bad ïa ki jingkhawai niam,
da kaba pyntngit ïa ka ïing bakhuid bad ïa ki lyngdoh,
da kaba tei ki duwan, ki ïingniam bad ki ïingblei na ka bynta ki bleithaw, da kaba kñia da ki sniang bad da ki mrad ki bymkhuid,
bad da kaba phah ieh noh khlem otsher ïa ki khun shynrang jong ki. Ki dei ban pynbyrsieh ïa lade da ki jingleh ki bymkhuid bad ki basang,
khnang ba kin dup klet ïa ka niam bad kin dup pynkylla noh ïa ki riti niam baroh.
“Bad jar ubym kohnguh ïa kata ka hukum jong u syiem, u dei ban ïap.”
Da kum kine ki ktien u la thoh sha ka hima jong u baroh kawei. U la thung ki nongpeit halor u paidbah baroh bad u la ai hukum ba ki shnong Judea baroh, kawei pa kawei, ki dei ban tyrwa jynkñia.
Bun bah ki briew, kat kiba la ieh noh ïa ka niam, ki la bud ïa ki, bad ki la leh bymman ha ka ri.
Ki la pynher krad ïa ki Israel ban leit rieh kat shaba ïoh jaka rieh.
Ka la jia ba ha ka sngi ka bakhatsan jong u ’nai Kisleb, ha ka snem 145 [167 SK], ki la pynïeng ka duwan blei thaw halor ka duwan jingkñia thang. Ki la tei sa ki duwan kylleng sawdong ki shong Judea,
bad ki la thang dhup ha ki dwar ïing bad ha ki surok shnong.
Ïa ki kitab baroh jong ka niam, katba ki lap, ki la tar lyngkhot lyngkhai bad ki la thang da ka ding.
Lada ki lap ba uno uno u briew u don ïa ka kitab jong ka jutang, ne lada uno uno u dang pynïadei ïa lade bad ka niam, ïa uta la rai pynïap da ka hukum jong u syiem.
Man la u bnai la thom jubor ïa ki Israel, ïa kito baroh ba ki lap ha ki shnong ki thaw.
Ha ka sngi ka ba-arphew san jong uta u bnai ki la tyrwa ka jingkñia halor kata ka duwan kaba la don halor ka duwan jingkñia thang.
Katkum ka hukum, ki la pynïap ïa ki kynthei kiba phah otsher ïa la ki khun ki kti,
baroh shi ïing shi sem, bad kito kiba la otsher ïa ki; ki la sdien ïa ki khyllung ha ki ryndang jong ki kmie jong ki.
Hynrei la don bun ruh ha Israel kiba la ïeng skhem bad kiba la kut jingmut ha la dohnud ba kin ym bam ïa ka jynbam ka bymkhuid.
Ki la jied ban ïap ban ïa ka ban pynbyrsieh ïa lade da kata jynbam ne ïa kaban pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bakhuid; te ki la ïap.
Ka jingbitar shla ka bakhraw ka la hiar halor ki Israel.
Ha kito ki sngi u Matathias, u khun jong u Ïoannis, u khun jong u Simeon, u lyngdoh jong u khun u Joarib, u la mih na Jerusalem bad u la leit shong shnong ha Modeiñ.
Une u la don san ngut ki khun shynrang, u Ïoannis u ba la sin kyrteng u Gaddi,
u Simon uba ki la khot u Thassi,
u Judas uba ki la khot u Makabeus,
u Eleasar uba ki la khot u Abaran, bad u Jonathan uba ki la khot u Apphus.
U la ïohi ïa ka jingleh sang ba la leh ha Judea bad ha Jerusalem,

hangta u la ong, “Ani wow! Balei sha la kha ïa nga ban ïohi kat kane, la jot thiaw ki briew jong nga, la jot thiaw ka nongbah bakhuid, bad ma nga pat ban shong lyngngai haba aiti ïa ka ha ki nongshun, haba aiti ïa ka ïing bakhuid ha ki mynder?
Ka Tempyl jong ka ka la kylla kum u briew khlem burom;
ïa ki tiar leh niam kiba ai burom ïa ka la knieh bad la rong noh. Ïa ki khunlung jong ka la pynïap ha ki lynti shnong jong ka, kumjuh ïa ki samla da ka waitlam jong u dusmon.
Kaei ka jait bynriew kabym shym la ïoh bynta na ka hima jong ka, kabym shym la kurup jubor ïa ka?
Ïa ki jynriam ba-itynnat jong ka la knieh beiñ na ka; kam laitluid shuh, ka la kylla ka mraw.
Ha peit seh, ïa ka jaka bakhuid jong ngi, ïa ka jingbhabriew jong ngi, wat ïa ka burom jong ngi la pynlko pom; ki Jentil ki la leh sang ïa ka.
Banlei ngi dei ban dang ïa-im shuh?
Te u Matathias bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ, ki la phong da ki jaiñ khaiñ bad ki la leh khuslai shibun eh.
Te ki rangbah syiem kiba dei ban pynbor ïa ka jinglehniam ki la wan poi sha ka shnong Modeiñ ban phah kñia ïa ki.
Bun bah ki Israel ki la ïaleit sha ki; u Matathias bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la ïadon lang khrui.
Te ki rangbah syiem ki la kren kumne ha u Matathias, “Phi phi long u rangbah duh, uba ki burom bad ki ñiew rangbah ha kane ka shnong, uba don ruh ki khun shynrang bad ki hynmen para kiba kyrshan.

To ale wan nyngkong ma phi ban leh ïa kata kaba u syiem u hukum, kumba ki Jentil baroh bad ki rangbah Judea bad kito baroh kiba dang sah ha Jerusalem ki la leh. Kumta yn sa ñiew ïa phi bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi kum ki lok jong u syiem, bad yn sa burom ruh ïa phi bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi da ka rupa, ka ksiar bad bun ki jynai sngewbha.”

Hynrei u Matathias u la jubab da ka sur ka bajam, “Wat lada ki paid bynriew baroh kiba im hapoh ka hima u syiem ki kohnguh ïa u, bad ki mon ban leh ïa ki hukum jong u, bad man la u briew u leh lyndet ïa ka niam jong ki kpa tymmen jong u,
nga te bad ki khun shynrang jong nga bad baroh shipara ngin im da ka jutang jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi.
Horkit hordang ngan ym ieh noh ïa ka niam bad ïa ki riti niam.
Ngim treh ban kohnguh ïa ki ktien u syiem da kaba lyndet ïa la ka niam sha kamon ne sha kadiang.”
U tang shu dep kren ïa kine ki ktien, katba baroh ki ïohi, uwei u Ju u la wan shakhmat ban tyrwa jynkñia halor ka duwan ha Modeiñ, katkum ka hukum u syiem.
Haba u Matathias u la ïohi ïa kata, u la mehding lain kum ka ding, bad ka dohnud ka la kyndeh. Kumba dei hok ban bitar, um lah shah shuh; u la tur thrait bad u la pynïap ïa u halor ka duwan.
Ha kajuh ka por u la pynïap ïa uta u rangbah syiem uba la pynbor ïa ki ban kñia, bad u la pynpra ïa kata ka duwan.
U la khie shongshit kum ka ding na ka bynta ka niam kumba la leh u Phinehas pyrshah ïa u Zimri u khun jong u Salu.
Hangta u Matathias u la pyrta da ka sur ka bajam ha shnong, “To mih bad nga jar uba shong shit na ka bynta ka niam bad uba kyrshan ïa ka jutang!”
Ma u bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la phet bak sha ki lum bad ki la ieh noh katba don ha ka shnong.
Te bun bah kiba wad ïa ka hok bad ka jingleh hok ki la leit shong ha ri kynjah,
ma ki ryngkat bad ki khun shynrang, ki tnga bad ki jynri jong ki, namarba la bán khia palat ki jingjynjar halor jong ki.
La leit pyntip ha ki rangbah syiem, bad ha ki pyrton kiba don ha Jerusalem ka nongbah u Dabid, ba ki briew kiba la kyntait ïa ki hukum u syiem ki la phet sha ki jakarieh ha ri kynjah.
Bun ki la beh ïa ki nadien bad ki la lap ïa ki; ki la shong dara ha mar pyrshah jong ki bad ki la pynkhreh ban ïaleh thma ïa ki ha ka sngi sabath.
Ki la ong ha ki, “La biang katne! Ale mih bad to leh ïa kata kaba u syiem u hukum, kumta phin sa im.”
Hynrei ki Ju ki la phai ktien, “Ngin ym mih, lymne kohnguh ïa ka hukum u syiem ban leh sang kumta ïa ka sngi sabath”.
Hangta ki nongshun ki la leit bak bak ban ïaleh ïa ki.
Ki Israel kim shym leh kylliang ïa ki, ne kim shym kawang wat uwei u maw ïa ki, wat ïa ki jakarieh jong ki ruh kim shym set,
naba ki la ong, “Ai ba baroh ngin ïaïap kum kiba lui lui; ka bneng bad ka khyndew kin sa sakhi na ka bynta jong ngi ba phi pynïap bymhok ïa ngi.”
Kumta kita ki la ïaleh ïa ki ha ka sabath, bad ki la pynïap ïa ki bad tnga bad khun bad jynri jyndup, shihajar ngut ki briew.
Haba u Matathias bad ki lok jong u ki la tip shaphang kata, ki la khuslai jur na ka bynta jong ki.

Kumta ki la ïa-ong paralok, “Lada ngi leh kumba la leh ki para jait jong ngi bad ngim treh ban ïaleh ïa ki Jentil na ka bynta la ka jingim bad ki niam ki riti jong ngi, shen kin sa pynduh jait ïa ngi na ka pyrthei.”
Kumta ki la ïarai kumne ha kata ka sngi. “To ngin ïaleh ïa uno uno uba wan tur pyrshah ïa ngi ha ka sngi sabath. Hei! ngim dei ban ïap kumba la ïap ki para jait jong ngi ha kito ki jakarieh jong ki.”
Te la wan ïasynjuk lang bad ki shikynhun ki nong Hasidian, ki khlawait Israel ki bakhlaiñ bor, uwei pa uwei uba la kheiñduh ïa lade na ka bynta ka niam.
Baroh kiba la phet wir ban lait na ki jinglanot, ki la ïasoh bad ki bad ki la pynkhlaiñ ïa ki.
Ki la pynïeng ka kynhun shipai, bad ki la pynïap ïa ki nongkam sniew ha ka jingbitar jong ki bad ïa kiba leh be-aiñ ha ka jingingkhong jong ki; kat kiba lait-im, ki la leit rieh bad ki Jentil.
U Matathias bad ki lok jong u ki la shang kylleng bad ki la pynpra ïa ki duwan;
ki la otsher jubor ïa ki khynnah shynrang bym pat otsher, katba ki lap hapoh ki pud ka Israel.
Ki la bud dien sia ïa ki ’riewhangamei, bad ka kam ka la roi la par ha ki kti jong ki.
Ki la ïoh pyllaitluid ïa ka niam na ki kti jong ki Jentil bad ki syiem bad kim ju shah ïa u nongkam sniew ban leh trai khlieh.
Haba ki sngi ka jingïap u Matathias ki la jan, u la ong ha la ki khun shynrang, “Ka jinghangamei bad ka jingleh be-ijot ki la khlaiñ mynta; la poi ka por jong ka jingjot bad ka jingbitar shla.
Te kumta, ko khun jong nga, to long kiba shitrhem na ka bynta ka niam, bad to aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta ka jutang ki kpa tymmen jong ngi.
“To kynmaw ïa ki kam jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ba ki la leh ha la ki pateng pateng bynriew, bad phin sa ïoh ka burom bad ka nam kiban neh junom.
Hato ïa u Abraham ym shym la shem u bahok haba la tynjuh. hato ym shym la ñiew ba kata ka pynlong ïa u u bahok?
U Joseph u la sumar ïa ka niam ha ka por ka jingjynjar, bad u la kylla u kynrad ka Ijipt.
U Phinehas, u kpa tymmen jong ngi, namarba u shitrhem jur u la ïoh pdiang ka jutang jong ka jinglong lyngdoh shi junom.
U Joshwa namarba u la pyndep ïa ka hukum, u la kylla long u nongbishar ha Israel.
U Kaleb, na ka bynta ka sakhi jong u hakhmat ka jingïakynduh, u la ïoh ka nong pateng ha ka ri.
U Dabid, namarba u la long u bariewblei, U la ïoh pateng ka khet jong ka hima kaba neh junom.
Ïa u Elija, namarba u long uba shitrhem ïa ka niam, la rong noh sha bneng.
Ïa u Hanania, u Azaria, bad u Mishael, ba ki la ngeit, la pyllait im na ka lawar ding.
Ïa u Daniel, namarba u la long uba lui lui, la pyllait im na ka shyntur ki sing.
Te kumta to pyrkhat, pateng la pateng, ba kito kiba shaniah ha u Blei kin ym duna bor.
Hei! wat ju tieng ïa ki ktien u ’riewsniew, namarba ka maiñ kyr-eit jong u kan sa kylla u lum kruiñ.
Mynta ka sngi u heh kyrdan, lashai u jah lngaid, namarba u la leit phai sha ka khyndew, bad ki buit sianti jong u kin sa pulom ei.
Ko khun jong nga, to long ki bashlur, to long ki bashynrang na ka bynta ka niam, naba da ka phin sa ïoh burom.
“Te hakhmih nga tip ba u hynmen jong phi u Simeon u long u bastad buit; to shah shkor ïa u barabor; ai un long kum u kpa ïa phi.
U Judas Makabeus u la long u ’riewïaleh u bashlur naduh dang samla. Ma u un sa long u rangbah pyrton jong phi bad un sa pynïaid ïa ka pyrton thma pyrshah ki paid bynriew.
Phi dei ban lum lang bad phi ïa kito baroh kiba rakhe ïa ka niam, bad phi dei ban pynhiar kput na ka bynta ka jingleh sniew ïa ki briew jong phi.
Da leh kylliang ïa ki Jentil haban da suwan, bad to phikir ïa ki riti jong ka niam.”
Nangta u la kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa ki, bad la lum lang ïa u bad ki kpa tymmen jong u.
U la ïap ynda u la dap shispah sawphew hynriew snem ka ryta bad la tep ïa u ha ka jaka tep jong ki kpa tymmen jong u ha Modeiñ. Baroh shi Israel ki la ïam bynñiaw jur na ka bynta jong u.
Te u khun jong u u Judas ïa uba la sin kyrteng Makabeus, u la long rangbah nongïalam ha ka jaka jong u.
Baroh ki hynmen ki para bad kito baroh kiba la ïasynjuk lang bad u kpa jong u ki la kyrshan ïa u; da ka jingsngewbha ki la ïaleh thma na ka bynta ka Israel.

U la pynkhraw ïa ka burom jong ki paid jong u. Kum u ’riewradbah u la kieng ïa ka stieh shadem; u la phong ïa ka jynkieng atiar thma, bad u la ïaleh bun ki thma, ban ïada ïa la ki paid da ka waitlam jong u.
U la long kum u sing ha ki kam shlur jong u, kum u khun sing uba kyrhuh ban ïoh mrad.
U la wad bad u la bud dien ïa ki ’riewbe-aiñ; u la thang duh ïa kito kiba pynsaja ïa ki briew jong u.
Ki ’riewbe-aiñ ki la pynrit ria ba ki tieng ïa u, baroh ki ’riewdakaid ki la shaïong; bad ka jingpyllait ka la ïaid shaphrang ha ka jingïalam jong u.
U la pynkthang ïa bun ki syiem, hynrei u la pynsngewbha ïa u Jakob da ki kam jong u. Ϊa u la kynmaw bad la kyrkhu junom.
U la ïaid lyngba ki nongbah ka Judea; u la pynduh pyndam ïa ki bakhlem blei na ka ri; kumta u la pynphai noh ïa ka jingbitar na Israel.
La bna nam ïa u shaduh bakut ka pyrthei, bad u la ai mynsiem ïa kito kiba lajan ïap.
Hynrei u Apollonius u la lum lang ïa ki Jentil bad ka pyrton thma ka baheh na Samaria ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel.
U Judas, u tang shu tip liak ïa kata, u la leit bak bak ban ïakynduh ïa u; u la pynher krad ïa u bad u la ïoh pynïap ïa u. Bun bah ki la mynsaw bad ki la ïap, kiba sah ki la phet krad.
Te ki la knieh ïa ka mar kliarwait na ki; u Judas pat u la shim ïa ka waitlam jong u Apollonius, bad u la pyndonkam ïa ka haba ïaleh thma katba u dang im.
Te ka la jia haba u Seron, u rangbah duh jong ka pyrton Siria, u la ïohsngew ba u Judas u la lum ka kynhun ka bakhraw, kaba tang ki ’riewngeit suda kiba shaniah ha u bad kiba la kyrïaw ha ka thma,
u la ong, “Ngan sa ïoh nam ïa lade bad ka burom ruh ha ka hima lada nga ïaleh thma ïa u Judas bad ki lok jong u, kiba la ñiewbeiñ ïa ka hukum u syiem.”
Te kumta u pyrton u bakhlaiñ jong ki ’riewkhlemblei ban kyrshan ïa u ka la khih thma tik ban pynhiar kput halor ki khun Israel.
Ynda u la poi hajan ranab Beth-horon, u Judas u la leit tur sha u da ka kynhun ka barit.

Te haba ki la ïohi ïa uta u pyrton bah kaba la wan tur ïa ki, ki la ong ha u Judas, “Kumno keiñ, ma ngi kiba tang khyndiat ngut ngi lah ban ïaleh ïa u paid u babun bad u bakhlaiñ katta katta? Ngi sngew lwait ruh artat namarba ngim shym bam ei ei mynta ka sngi.”
U Judas u la phai ktien, “Ka long ka bajem ba ki babun kin shah rem ha ki bakhyndiat, naba hakhmat ka Bneng, ym don jingïapher napdeng ka jingpyllait da ki babun ne da ki bakhyndiat.
Ka jingjop ha ka thma kam shong eh ha ka jingheh paid heh pyrton shipai, hynrei ka jingkhlaiñ ka wan na Bneng.
Ma ki ki wan pyrshah ïa ngi da ka jingsarong bad ka jingleh be-aiñ ka bakhraw ban pynïap ïa ngi, ïa ki tnga jong ngi, ïa ki khun ki kti jong ngi, bad ban knieh na ngi nadong shadong.
Hynrei ngi ngi ïaleh na ka bynta ka jingim lajong bad ki niam lajong.
U Blei hi Un sa kyrñiom ïa ki hakhmat jong ngi; ma phi wat tieng ei ei ïa ki.
Mar ïadep kren, u la tur kynsan kynsan pyrshah ïa u Seron bad ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong u, bad u la thom lin ïa ki.
Ki la beh ïa ki nadien arsut kata ka ranab Beth-horon haduh sha ri thor; phraspah ngut na ki ki la kyllon, bad kiwei pat ki la phet ïap shaduh ka ri ki Philistia.
Hangta ki la sdang ban tieng ïa u Judas bad ïa ki hynmen para jong u, bad ki Jentil kiba don sawdong jong ki ki la sngewtriem her.
Ka nam jong u ka la poi haduh u syiem, bad ki Jentil ki la ïalap shaphang ki thma u Judas.
Haba u syiem Antiokhus u la ïohsngew ïa kine ki jingjia, u la khie bitar tyngeh, bad u la phah ban lum lang ïa ki shipai baroh jong ka hima jong u, u pyrton bah bakhlaiñ.
U la plie ïa ki synduk tyngka jong u bad u la siew tulop ïa ki shipai jong u baroh shi snem, u da ai hukum artat ba ki dei ban long kiba la kloi katba donkam.

Te u la ïohi ba ka tyngka na ki synduk ka la rwa, bad ba ka khajna na ka ri ka la duna na ka daw ka jingïakhih bad ka jingjynjar kaba u la leh hi ha ka ri da kaba pynduh ïa ki aiñ kiba la ju don naduh hyndai hynthai.
U la sdang ban tieng ïoh um ïoh pisa shuh kumba ju ïoh, na ka bynta ki jynlut jynsep bad ki jynai sngewbha kiba u shait ai kham palat ban ïa kaba la ju leh kiwei pat ki syiem kiba mynshuwa jong u.
U la dumbuit jlang ha ka jingmut, kumta u la rai ban leit hiar thma ïa ka Persha, ban dup ïoh lum khajna na kito ki thaiñ bad ban ïoh pynmih pisa shikatdei.
U la thung ïa u Lisias, u ’riewdonburom na ka jait syiem, ban peit ïa ki kam jong u syiem naduh ka wah Ïuphratis shaduh khap-pud Ijipt,
bad ban peit ruh ïa u Antiokhus, u khun lajong, haduh ba un da wan phai.
U la ai bynta ha u Lisias marshiteng na ki shipai ki swar jong u bad ki hati, bad u la ai hukum ha u shaphang kiei kiei baroh ba u kwah ba un leh. Shaphang ki trai shnong Judea bad Jerusalem,

u Lisias u dei ban phah kawei ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ki ban ïuh roit bad ban pynjot thiaw ïa ka bor jong ka Israel bad kiba dang sah ha Jerusalem; hana ba u dei ban pynduh pyndam pynban, ban ym kynmaw shuh ïa ki ha kata ka jaka,
u dei ban pynshong shnong da ki nongwei ha ka ri jong ki, bad ban ïasam bynta artat ïa ka khyndew ka shyiap jong ki.

Nangta u syiem u la shim ïa ki shipai jong u kiba dang sah marshiteng, bad u la mih na Antiokh ka nongbah jong u ha ka snem shispah sawphew hynñiew. U la jam sha shiliang ka wah Ïuphratis bad u la leit lyngba ki jylla ki bashaneng.
Te u Lisias u la jied ïa u Ptolemi u khun jong u Dorimenes, ïa u Nikanor bad ïa u Gorjias, ki briew ki badonbor hapdeng ki lok u syiem,
bad u la phah ïa ki lem bad sawphew hajar ngut ki shipai kjat bad hynñiew hajar ki pyrton kulai ban hiar thma ïa ka ri Judea bad ban pynjot ïa ka kumba u syiem u la hukum.
Kumta ki la mih bad ka kynhun jong ki baroh kawei, bad ynda ki la poi ki la shong dara ha ka madan kaba hajan Emmaus.

Haba ki nongkhaïi ha kata ka thaiñ ki la bna shaphang jong ki, ki la rah shikatdei ka rupa bad ka ksiar lem bad ki kynjri, bad ki la leit sha kata ka jaka dara ban dup ïoh ring mraw da ki khun Israel. Ki pyrton na Siria bad na ri ki Philistia ki la bud lang ïa ki.

Te u Judas bad ki hynmen para jong u ki la ïohi ba ki jingjynjar ki la nangbun bad ba ki pyrton ki la shong dara hapoh ka ilaka jong ki. Ki la tip ruh ba u syiem u la hukum ban pynduh thiaw ïa ka jait bynriew.
Hynrei ki la ïa-ong para ma ki, “To ngin ïatei biang ïa la ka jaitbynriew, bad to ngin ïaleh na ka bynta ki briew bad ka tempyl jong ngi.”
U paidbah u la ïalum lang ban pynkhreh ïaleh thma, bad ban duwai bad ban kyrpad jingisynei bad jingsngewlem.

Ka Jerusalem ka la sah kynjah khlem shong briew; ym don wat uwei na ki khun jong ka uba rung uba mih. Ïa ka ïing bakhuid la ïuh roit, bad ki khun jong ki mynder ki don ha ka nongbah; ka la long ka jaka shong ki Jentil, Ym don jingkmen shuh ïa u Jakob; ka sharati bad ka duitara kim tem shuh.
Te ki la ïalum lang bad ki la leit sha Mizpa, hamar pyrshah Jerusalem, namar mynshuwa eh ki Israel ki la don ka jaka jingduwai ha Mizpa.
Ki la shah jingit ha kata ka sngi, ki la phong ki jaiñ byrni bad ki la ber ïa la ki khlieh da u dpei, nangta ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ.
Ki la plied ïa ka kitab jong ka niam ban wad jingmut shaphang ki kam kumba ki Jentil ki wad buit na ki dur jong ki blei jong ki.
Ki la wan rah ruh ïa ki jaiñ lyngdoh, ïa ki soh nyngkong bad ïa ka bashiphew, nangta ki la pynmih ïa ki Nasir kiba la lah pyndep ïa la ki jingkular niam;
bad ki sa pyrta jam sha Bneng, ki ong, “Ngin leh aïu ïa kine? Shano ngin ïalam ïa ki?
Ïa ka jaka bakhuid jong Me la ïuh roit bad la leh sang, ki lyngdoh jong Me ki khuslai ba la pynjah burom.
Hakhmih, ki Jentil ki ïalum lang pyrshah ïa ngi ban pynjot ïa ngi; ma Me Mem tip aïu ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa ngi.
Kumno ngin lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki, lada ma Me Mem ïarap ïa ngi?
Te nangta ki la put ïa ki turoi bad ki la risa jam.
Hadien kata, u Judas u la thung ki nongïalam na ki paidbah ban ïalam ïa ki hajar bad ki spah, ïa ki sanphew bad ki shiphew.
U la ong ha kito kiba ïatei ïing, ne kiba la ïateh poikha, ne kiba thung brisoh waiñ, ne kiba lam tieng, ba uwei pa uwei u dei ban leit phai sha la ïing la ïing, katkum ka aiñ.
Nangta ka pyrton thma ka la ïaid shaphrang bad ka la shong dara shathie na Emmaus.

Hangta u Judas u la ong, “To pynkhreh ïa lade bad to long ki bashynrang. To long kiba la kloi dang step phyrngap ban ïaleh ïa kine ki Jentil kiba la ïalum lang ban pynjot ïa ngi bad ïa ka jaka bakhuid jong ngi.
Ka bha ba ngi ïap ha ka thma ban ïa kaban ïohi ïa ka jingjot jingpra jong ka jait bynriew jong ngi bad jong ka jaka bakhuid.
Hynrei kumba long ka mon jong u Blei ha bneng, kumta keiñ Un leh.”
Te u Gorjias u la shim sanhajar ki shipai kjat bad shihajar ki pyrton kulai ki bakynsai, bad kane ka kynhun ka la mih sor mynmiet
ban kynrup ïa ka jaka dara ki Ju bad ban ïaleh ïa ki kyndit kyndit. Ki briew kiba ha ka kut shnong ki la ïalam lynti ïa ki.
Hynrei u Judas u la lah tip ïa kata, kumta ma u bad ki ’riewthma jong u ki la mih ban ïaleh ïa ki pyrton u syiem ha Emmaus,
haba kata ka kynhun kam don ha ka jaka dara.
Haba u Gorjias u la rung hapoh jaka dara jong u Judas mynmiet, um shym lap ïano ïano hangta, kumta u la wad ïa ki ha ki lum, namar u la ong, “Kine ki briew ki la phet ïap na ngi.”
Tang mar ïakynjat shai u Judas u la mih bluit ha kata ka madan lem ban lai hajar ngut ki briew, hynrei kim shym don tiar thma bad ki waitlam kumba ki la kwah.
Ki la ïohi ïa ka jaka dara jong ki Jentil, ba la kerkut triang, lem bad ki pyrton kulai sawdong jong ka; baroh ki ’riewthma kiba la pyntbit bha.
Hynrei u Judas u la ong ha ki briew kiba ïadon bad u, “Wat tieng ïa ka jingbun paid jong ki, wat khaw-eit haba ki tur.
To kynmaw kumno ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi la pyllait ha Duriaw Basaw, mynba u Pharo bad ki pyrton thma jong u ki la beh ïa ki nadien.

To mynta ngin ïapyrta sha Bneng, ban peit lada u Blei Un leh isynei ïa ngi bad Un kynmaw ïa la ka jutang bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi, bad Un ïuh roit ïa une u pyrton shipai uba hakhmat jong ngi mynta ka sngi.
Hangta baroh ki Jentil kin sa tip ba don Uwei Uba pyllait bad Uba pynim ïa ki Israel.
Haba kita ki nongwei ki la peit bad ki la ïohi ïa ki ba ki wan tur pyrshah ïa ki,
ki la mih bluit na la ka jaka dara ban ïaleh thma. Kumta ki briew kiba don bad u Judas ki la put ïa la ki turoi,
bad ki la ïaleh thma. Ki Jentil ki la rem bad ki la phet ïap shaduh ri thor,
bad kito kiba sah hadien ki la kyllon da ka waitlam. Ki la beh sia ïa ki shaduh Gasara bad shaduh ri thor Idumea, haduh Azotus bad Jamnia, bad lai hajar ngut na ki ki la kyllon.
Kumta u Judas bad ki ’riewthma jong u ki la phai dien noh khlem thwet shuh ïa ki,
bad u la ong ha ki paidbah, “Wat nap ha ka kurup, namar ngi dang don thma shuh;
u Gorjias bad ki pyrton jong u ki don hajan jong ngi ha ki lum. Mynta ïeng pyn-eh triang ïa ki nongshun jong ngi, bad hadien kata sa kurup katba mon.”
Mar ïadep kren u Judas, shikynhun ki la wan mih na ki lum.
Ki la ïohi ba ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ki la pynher krad, bad ba ki Ju ki la thang ïa ka jaka dara jong ki, naba ka tdem kaba ki la ïohi ka la pyni ïa kata kaba la jia.
Haba ki la ïohi ïa kane ki la tieng her, bad haba ki la ïohi sa ïa ka kynhun shipai u Judas ba ka ïeng shriak ha madan na ka bynta ka thma,
ki la phet sha ka ri ki Philistia.
Hangta u Judas u la wan phai ban knieh ïa ka jaka dara, bad ki la ïoh shikatdei ka ksiar, ka rupa, ki jaiñ rongjngum bad sawbthuh, bad ka spah ka hajar shibun bah.
Ynda ki wan phai ki la rwai ki jingrwai ïaroh sha u Blei, naba U long u babha, naba ka jingieid sbun jong U ka neh junom.”
Kumta ki Israel ki la ïoh ka jingpyllait ka bakhraw ha kata ka sngi.
Kito ki nongwei kiba la ïoh phet ki la leit ïathuh ha u Lisias ïa kata kaba la jia.
Ynda u la ïohsngew ïa kata, u la shaïong bad u la ma, naba ym shym la jia ïa ki Israel kumba u la mut, bad kam shym urlong kumba u syiem u la hukum ïa u.
Kumta ha kawei pat ka snem u la lum hynriewphew hajar ngut ki shipai kjat ki bakynsai bad san hajar ngut ki pyrton kulai ban pyndem ïa ki.
Ki la wan haduh Idumea bad ki la shong dara ha Beth-Zur, katba u Judas pat de u la pyn-ap ïa ki shiphew hajar ngut ki ’riewïaleh.

Haba u la ïohi ba kata ka kynhun shipai ka la long ka bakhlaiñ, u la duwai u da ong, “Long ba la kyrkhu ma Me, ko nongpynim ki Israel, Uba la pynlko ïa ka borbah jong u ’riewthma u bakhlaiñ da ka kti jong u shakri jong Me u Dabid, bad Uba la aiti ïa ka jaka dara jong ki Philistia ha ki kti u Jonathan, u khun jong u Saul, bad jong u nongkieng atiar jong u.
Te mynta ruh to ïuh roit ïa kane ka kynhun thma da ka kti jong ki paid Israel jong Me, bad to ai ba ki shipai bad ki pyrton kulai jong ki kin shah lehraiñ.
To pynlong ïa ki kiba khawpud; to pynsator ïa ka jingkhlaiñ bor jong ki; to ai kin khynñiuh ha ka jingjot jong ki.
To pynliem ïa ki da ka waitlam jong kito kiba ieid ïa Me bad to ai ba kito kiba tip ïa Me kin ïaroh ïa Me da ki jingrwai.”
Te kumta baroh ar liang ki la ïaleh, bad na ka kynhun shipai jong u Lisias san hajar ngut ki la kyllon ha ka jingïaleh.

Haba u Lisias u la ïohi ba ki shipai jong u ki la rem bad u la ithuh ïa ka jingshynrang jong ki shipai u Judas bad katno ki la kloi ban im lane ban ïap da kaba donburom, u la phet bak sha Antiokh bad u la wer nong ïa ki shipai, ban hiar thma biang ïa ka Judea da ka kynhun shipai ka bakham khraw.
Te u Judas bad ki hynmen para jong u ki la ong, “Ha peit, ki nongshun jong ngi ki la shah rem thiaw; ïa ngin ïaleit ban pynkhuid ïa ka tempyl bad ngin ïapynkyntang ïa ka.”
Kumta kata ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei ka la leit kiew sha u Lum Zion.

Ki la ïohi ba ka tempyl ka la kynjah, ba ïa ka duwan la leh sang, bad ba ïa ki khyrdop la thang. Ha ki phyllaw ki la ïohi ba ki bniap ki la khie sañium kum hapoh khlaw ne halor lum. Ki la ïohi ruh ba ki kamra jong ki lyngdoh ki la jot rynjaiñ.
Hangta ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ, ki la ïam sngewsih haduh katta katta, bad ki la ber ïa lade da u dpei.
Ki la dem phyllup ha khyndew, bad ki la ai dak da ka jingput ïa ki turoi, nangta ki la kyang sha Bneng.
U Judas u la buh ki briew kiban ïaleh ïa kito kiba dang don ha ka kut shnong, katba ma u u pynkhuid phloiñ ïa ka tempyl.
U la jied ki lyngdoh ki bakhlem thohria ha ka jingrakhe ïa ka niam,
bad ki la pynkhuid ïa ka tempyl bad ki la weng noh ïa ki maw ba la pyntngit sha ka jaka ka bymkhuid.
Ki la ïapyrkhat buit yn leh kumno ïa ka duwan jingkñia thang kaba la leh sang.
Te ki la pyrkhat ba ka long ka babha eh ban shu pynpra noh ïa ka, ïoh ki shah kynnoh sniew, naba ki Jentil ki la pynbyrsieh ïa ka. Kumta ki la pynpra ïa kata ka duwan,
bad ki la buh lang ïa ki maw ha kawei ka jaka ka babit ha uta u lum tempyl, haduh ba yn da wan u nongïathuhlypa u ban bthah ïa ki yn leh aïu ïa ki.
Kumta ki la shim da ki maw bakhlem shniah, kumba bthah ka niam, bad ki la tei kawei ka duwan ka bathymmai kum ka bamynshuwa.
Ki la tei biang ïa ka jaka kyntang bad ïa ka tempyl na shapoh ïing, bad ki la pynkhuid phloiñ ïa ki phyllaw.
Ki la thaw thymmai ïa ki khiew ki pliang ki bakhuid, bad ki la wan rah ïa ka jynpynïeng sharak, ïa ka duwan jyniwbih, bad ïa ka miej hapoh ka tempyl.
Nangta ki la thang ïa ka jyniwbih halor ka duwan bad ki la thang ïa ki sharak halor ka jynpynïeng sharak, bad kine ki la pynshai ïa ka tempyl.
Ki la buh ïa u kpu halor ka miej bad ki la wah ïa ki pyrda. Kumta ki la pyndep nadong shadong ïa ka kam ba ki la leh.
Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi ka ba-arphew san jong u bnai u bakhyndai, uba dei u ’nai Kisleb, ha ka snem shispah sawphew phra,
ki la khie bad ki la tyrwa jynkñia, kumba hukum ka niam, halor ka duwan jingkñia thang ka bathymmai kaba ki la tei.
Ha kata hi ka aïom bad ha kata hi ka sngi ba ki Jentil ki la leh sang ïa ka, la pynkyntang ïa ka da ki jingrwai bad ki duitara, da ki sharati bad ki shakuriaw.
Baroh ki paidbah ki la dem pyllup, ki la mane bad ki la kyrkhu ïa u Blei ka Bneng, Uba la pynmanbha manmiat ïa ki.
Kumta ki la pynkyntang ïa ka duwan da ki jingleh burom kumba phra sngi, bad ki la tyrwa ki jynkñia thang da ka jingkmen; ki la tyrwa ka jingkñia jingpyllait bad jingïaroh.
Ki la pynitynnat ïa ka khmat jong ka tempyl da ki pansngiat ksiar bad ki stieh rit; ki la maramot ïa ki khyrdop bad ïa ki kamra jong ki lyngdoh, bad ki la shna ki jynkhang na ka bynta jong ki.
La don ka jingkmen ka bakhraw hapdeng ki paidbah, bad la weng ïa ka jingjah burom ba leh ki Jentil.

Te u Judas bad ki hynmen para jong u lem bad ki Israel baroh kiba ïalum lang ki la rai ba man la ka snem, ha kata ka aïom, ïa ki sngi jong ka jingpynkyntang ïa ka duwan dei ban rakhe da ka jingkmen bad ka jingleh sngewbha kumba phra sngi; yn sdang naduh ka sngi ka ba-arphew san jong u ’nai Kisleb.
Ha kata ka por ki la kerkut ïa u Lum Zion da ki kynroh ki bakynjang bad ki jyntei kut ki bakhlaiñ baroh sawdong, ban ïada ïoh wan ki Jentil ban ïuh roit ïa ki kumba ki la leh mynshuwa.
U la buh ka kynhun ap karod ban peit ïa ka. U la pynkhlaiñ ïa ka Beth-Zur ruh, khnang ba ki paidbah kin dup don kawei ka kut mar pyrshah ka Idumea.
Haba ki Jentil kiba don sawdong ki la ïohsngew ba la lah tei ïa ka duwan, bad ba ïa ka tempyl la pynkyntang kumba ka la long mynshuwa, ki la bitar,
bad ki la kut jingmut ban pynïap-duh ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob kiba la shong hapdeng jong ki. Kumta ki la sdang ban pynïap bad ban pynduh ïa kito kiba don bad ki.

Hangta u Judas u la ïaleh thma ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Esaw kiba ha Idumea ha ki thaiñ Akrabattene, namarba ki ju ap thap ïa ki Israel. U la jop thiaw ïa ki bad u la pynrit ria ïa ki, nangta u sa kurup ïa ki.
U la kynmaw ruh ïa ka jingbymman jong ki khun ki ksiew u Baean, kiba la long ka jingsyier bad ka jynriam ïa ki paidbah, da ki jingpynap jong ki ha ki lynti bah.
U la set sbak ïa ki ha ki ïingkut jong ki bad u la kerkut ïa ki, u la kular ban pynduh khoit ïa ki, bad u la thang da ka ding ïa ki ïingkut jong ki bad ïa ki briew baroh kiba la don hapoh hangta.
Nangta u la leit sha shiliang ban ïaleh sa ïa ki Ammon; u la lap ba ki don ka kynhun ka bakhlaiñ bad ka babun paid hapoh ka jingïalam u Timothi.
U la ïaleh bun ki thma bad ki, bad ki la rem thiaw; u la pom lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki.
Ynda u la ïoh knieh ïa ka Jazer bad ki nongrit jong ka, u la wan phai sha Judea.
Te ki Jentil kiba ha Gilead ki la ïalum lang pyrshah ïa ki Israel kiba shong shnong bad ki, bad ki la wad buit ban pynïap ïa ki. Pynban ki la phet sha ka kut ha Dathema,
bad ki la phah sha u Judas bad ki hynmen para jong u ka shithi kaba ong kumne, “Ki Jentil kiba don sawdong jong ngi ki la ïalum lang ban pynïap ïa ngi.
Ki dang ïapynkhreh ban wan knieh ïa ka kut sha kaba ngi la leit phet rieh bad u Timothi u long u nongïalam jong ki shipai jong ki.
To ale seh ban pyllait ïa ngi na ki kti jong ki, naba bun na ngi ki la kyllon,
bad ki para jait jong ngi kiba don ha ri Tob ki la shah pynïap. Ki nongshun ki la kem ïa ki tnga jong ki, bad khun bad tiar bad tar, bad ki la pynïap jin shihajar ngut ha kata ka thaiñ.”
Katba dang pule ïa kata ka shithi, sa kiwei pat ki nongrah khubor, rynjaiñ da ki jaiñ kiba la kad, ki la wan poi na Galilea bad ki la ai kajuh ka khubor.
Ki la ong ba pyrshah ïa ki la ïalum lang ki briew kiba na Ptolemais, na Tirus bad na Sidon, bad baroh ka Galilea jong ki Jentil, “ban pynduh khoit ïa ngi.”
Haba u Judas bad ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kine ki khubor, la khot lang shikatdei bah ki briew ban ïarai kumno yn leh na ka bynta ki para jait kiba shem jynjar, kiba shah leh beiñ ha ki nongshun.
Hangta u Judas u la ong ha u Simon u para jong u, “To jied ki briew kiban leit bad phi ban pyllait ïa la ki para jait ha Galilea; nga bad u Jonathan u para jong nga ngin leit sha Gilead.”
Hynrei u la ieh noh ïa u Jospeh, u khun jong u Zekharia, bad ïa u Azaria, u rangbah nongïalam jong u paidbah, bad ki shipai kiba dang sah, ban ap karod ïa ka Judea.
U la ai hukum ïa ki kumne, “To sumar ïa une u paidbah, hynrei wat ïaleh thma ïa ki Jentil haduh ba ngin da wan phai.”
Kumta la ai briew lai hajar ngut ha u Simon ban leit sha Galilea, bad phra hajar ngut ha u Judas ban leit sha Gilead.
Kumta u Simon u la leit sha Galilea bad u la ïaleh bun ki thma pyrshah ïa ki Jentil, bad ki Jentil ki la shah rem hakhmat jong u.
U la beh ïa ki shaduh ka khyrdop jong ka Ptolemais, bad haduh lai hajar ngut ki Jentil ki la kyllon; nangta u la kurup ïa ki.
Kumta u la ïalam noh ïa ki Ju na Galilea bad Arbatta, bad tnga bad khun, kat kaba ki don baroh phar, bad u la wan ïalam ïa ki sha Judea da ka jingleh kmen ka bakhraw.
U Judas Makabeus bad u Jonathan u para jong u ki la kam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad ki la ïaid lai sngi lynti ha ri kynjah.
Ki la ïakynduh ïa ki Nabatean, kiba la pdiang da ka jingsuk jingsaiñ ïa ki, bad ki la ïathuh ïa ki kat kaba la jia ïa ki para jait jong ki ha Gilead:

“Bun na ki ki la shah set ha Bozra bad Bosor, ha Alema bad Khaspho, Maked bad Karnaim”—baroh kine ki nongbah ki la long ki bakhlaiñ ba ki baheh—“don ruh kiwei pat katto katne kiba la shah khangdong ha kiwei pat ki nongbah ka Gilead. U nongshun u la pynkhreh ban ïaleh ïa ki kut lashai, ban knieh ïa ki bad ban pynïap ïa kine ki briew baroh ha ka shisngi.”

Hangta u Judas bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la phai wak dadien da ka lynti ri kynjah shaduh Bozra. U la jop ïa kata ka nongbah, bad ki la pynïap ïa u kynja shynrang baroh da ka waitlam. Ynda u la knieh lut ïa ka mar kliarwait, u la thang ïa ka da ka ding.
U la mih nangta shi miet shi miet, bad ki la leit shaduh ka kut Dathema.
Tang shu kynjat shai ki la peit, bad hakhmih kawei ka kynhun bah ka bym lah ñiew, kaba rah ki jynkieng bad ki kor thma ban knieh ïa ka kut, bad ban ïaleh ïa ki Ju kiba la don hapoh.
Kumta u Judas u la ïohi ba ka thma ka la lah sdang, bad ba ka jingpyrta nangta napoh ka nongbah ka la kiew sha Bneng lem bad ki turoi bad ki jingkynkaw ki bajam.
Te u la ong ha ki briew jong u, “To ïaleh mynta ka sngi na ka bynta ki para jait lajong!”
Te u la phah leit nadien jong ki lai kynhun, da kaba put ïa ki turoi, da kaba pyrta jam bad da kaba duwai.
Haba ki kynhun shipai u Timothi ki la sngewthuh ba dei u Makabeus, ki la her ïap nakhmat jong u, bad u la pynduh thiaw ïa ki. Haduh phra hajar ngut na ki ki la kyllon ha kata ka sngi.
Nangta u la phai sa sha Alema; u la ïaleh ïa ka bad u la ïoh knieh ïa ka. U la pynïap ïa u kynja shynrang baroh, u la kurup ïa ka, u sa thang pat da ka ding ïa ka.
Nangne u la leit tur shaphrang bad u la ïoh knieh ïa ka Khaspho, ka Maked, ka Bosor bad ïa kiwei pat ki nongbah ha Gilead.
Hadien kine kiei kiei u Timothi u la lum lang da kawei pat ka kynhun shipai bad u la shong dara ha marpyrshah Raphon, sha shiliang ka wahduid.
U Judas u la phah ki briew ban syntiat ïa kata ka jaka dara, bad ki la wan ïathuh ïa u, “Ki Jentil baroh kiba don sawdong jong ngi ki la leit lang bad u; ka long ka kynhun ka baheh shibun.
Ki la wer nong wat ïa ki Arab ban ïarap ïa ki, bad ki la ïashong dara sha shiliang ka wahduid, ki la pynkhreh ban wan ïaleh ïa phi.” U Judas u la leit ban ïakynduh ïa ki.

Te katba u Judas bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki wan haduh jan ka wahduid, u Timothi u la ong ha ki rangbah shipai jong ki pyrton jong u, “Lada u jam nyngkong ma u shane sha shiliang, ngin ym lah ban shan pyrshah ïa u, naba un jop da shisha shisha ïa ngi.
Hynrei lada u leh tieng bad u shong dara shatai sha shiliang wah, ngin leit tur ma ngi sha u bad ngin jop ïa u.”

Haba u Judas u la wan hajan kata ka wahduid, u la buh ïa ki rangbah lumpaid harud ka wah bad u la ai hukum ïa ki kumne, “Wat shah ïano ïano ban sah hapoh dara, hynrei phah baroh ba kin wan sha ka thma.”

Te u la jam nyngkong sha shiliang pyrshah ïa ki, bad ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei ka la bud ïa u. Ki Jentil baroh ki la shah rem hakhmat jong u, ki la bret ïa la ki tiar ïapom bad ki la her ïap shaduh ki ïingblei jong ki ha Karnaim.
Hynrei u la knieh ïa kata ka nongbah bad u la thang ïa ka da ka ding, tyllan bad kito kiba la don hapoh hangta. Kumta la jop ïa ka Karnaim; kim lah shuh ban shan pyrshah ïa u Judas.
Nangta u Judas u la lum lang baroh ki Israel kiba na Gilead, bad rit bad khraw, lem bad ki tnga bad ki khun bad ki mar ki mata, u paid byllien ban ïalam noh ïa ki sha Judea.

Kumta ki la wan poi ha Ephron. Kane ka la long ka nongbah ka baheh bad ka bakhlaiñ shibun eh harud lynti, bad kim lah ban ïaid tawiar ïa ka sha kamon ne sha kadiang; ki la dei ban shu ïaid lyngba jong ka.
Hynrei ki briew jong kata ka shnong ki la khang ïa ki shabar, bad ki la set ïa ki khyrdop da ki maw.

U Judas te u la phah kane ka khubor kum shilok shijor, “Shah seh ngin ïaid lyngba ka khyndew jong phi ba ngin leit sha la ka ri. Yn ym don ba leh sniew ïa phi; ngin shu ïaid lynti.” Hynrei kim treh satia ban plie ïa u.
Kumta u Judas u la hukum ban pynbna ha ka kynhun shipai jong u ba uwei pa uwei u dei ban shong dara hangta haba u don.
Kumta ki shipai ki la shong dara, bad u la ïaleh thma ïa kata ka nongbah baroh shi sngi shi miet, haduh ba u da ïoh knieh ïa ka.
U la pynïap ïa u kynja shynrang baroh da ka waitlam, u la pynjot ïa kata ka nongbah bad u la kurup ïa ka. Hadien kata u la ïaid lyngba kata ka shnong nalor ki met ïap.
Te ki la kam sha shiliang ka Jordan ha ka ri madan ka baheh hakhmat Bethshan.
U Judas u la lum lang ïa kiba ïaid saphret, da kaba ïaid pynshngaiñ artat artat lynti ïa ki paidbah haduh ba un da poi top ha ri Judea.
Kumta ki la leit kiew sha u Lum Zion da ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingkmen, bad ki la tyrwa ki jynkñia thang, naba ym shym ïap wat uwei u briew haba ki la wan phai.
Te katba u Judas bad u Jonathan ki la don ha Gilead, bad u Simon u para jong u u la don ha Galilea hakhmat Ptolemais,
u Joseph u khun u Zekharia, bad u Azaria, ki rangbah jong ki pyrton, ki la ïohsngew ïa ki kam shlur jong ki bad ïa ka thma ba ki la ïaleh.
Kumta ki la ïa- ong, “Ïa, ngi ruh ngin ïapynïoh nam ïa lade; ïa, ngin ïaleit ïaleh thma ïa ki Jentil kiba don sawdong jong ngi.
Kumta ki la pynmih hukum ha ki shipai jong ki pyrton jong ki, bad ki la leit hiar thma ïa ka Jamnia.
Te u Gorjias bad ki briew jong u ki la mih napoh shnong ban ïaleh thma bad ki.
U Joseph bad u Azaria ki la shah rem bad ïa ki la beh nadien haduh khap-pud Judea; haduh ar hajar ngut ki Israel ki la kyllon ha kata ka sngi.
Kumta ki paidbah ki la shah rem jur namar, da kaba tharai ban leh ka kam shlur, kim shym treh ban kohnguh ïa u Judas bad ïa ki para jong u.
Kine kim dei na kata ka ïing ka sem jong kito ki briew kiba la wan rah ka jingpyllait ïa ki Israel.
Ïa uta u Judas bad ïa ki para jong u la ai burom haduh katta katta da ki Israel baroh wat hapdeng ki Jentil baroh, kat haba la bna ïa ka kyrteng jong ki.
Ki briew ki la boi sawdong jong ki bad ki la ïaroh ïa ki.

Te u Judas bad ki para jong u ki la leit ïaleh sa ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Esaw ha ka ri ka bashathie. U la pom ïa ka Hebron bad ïa ki nongrit jong ka, u la pyntwa ïa ki kut jong ka bad u la thang ïa ki ïingkut kiba don sawdong jong ka.
Nangta u la leit tur shaduh ka ri ki Philistia, bad u la ïaid lyngba ka Marisa.
Ha kata ka sngi katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh kiba la kwah ban leh shlur ki la kyllon ha ka thma, naba ki la leit ïaleh thma khlem sngewthuh.

Hynrei u Judas u la ïaid pyrshing sha Azotus ha ka ri ki Philistia; u la pyntwa ïa ki duwan jong ki, bad u la thang ïa ki dur blei thaw jong ki da ka ding; u la kurup ïa ki shnong ki thaw, nangta u sa wan phai sha ri Judea.
U syiem Antiokhus u la ïaid lyngba ki jylla bashaneng haba u la ïohsngew ba ka Elimais ha Persha ka la long ka nongbah ka badonnam na ka bynta ka spah jong ka ha ka rupa bad ka ksiar.

Ka tempyl jong ka ka long ka bariewspah shibun, ka don ki stieh kiba da ka ksiar, ki jyndeng shadem, bad ki tiar thma ba la ieh noh hangta da u Aleksander, u khun u Philip, u syiem Masedonia uba la synshar halor ki Grik.
Kumta u la wan bad u la pyrshang ban knieh ïa kata ka nongbah bad ban kurup ïa ka, hynrei um shym lah, namarba ki briew jong kata ka nongbah ki la tip ïa ka buit jong u,
bad ki la ïashan tyngeh pyrshah ïa u ha ka thma. Kumta u la phet bad da ka jingsngewsih ka bakhraw u la mih noh nangta ban leit phai sha Babilon.
Nangta don kiba la wan ban ïathuh ïa u ha Persha ba ki kynhun shipai kiba la leit sha ri Judea ki la shah rem;

ba u Lisias u la leit nyngkong lem bad ka kynhun shipai ka bakhlaiñ, hynrei u la dei ban phai dien bad ban phet nakhmat ki Ju; ba ki Ju ki la nangkhlaiñ namarba ki la ïoh ki tiar thma, ki tiar ki tar, bad shikatdei ki mar kliarwait kiba ki la ïoh knieh na ki kynhun shipai kiba ki la jop;

ba ki la pynpra ïa ka jyntei sang baisaitmet kaba u la tei halor ka duwan ha Jerusalem; bad ba ki la ker tawiar ïa ka tempyl da ki kynroh ki bakynjang kum mynshuwa, bad ïa ka Beth-Zur ruh ka nongbah jong u.
Haba u syiem u la ïohsngew ïa kane, u la lyngngoh jlang bad u la khuslai jur. U la leit thiah namarba u la kem pang da ka jingpait dohnud, ba kiei kiei kim shym la urlong kumba u la mutdur.
U la thiah khop bun sngi, namarba la jur eh ka jingkhuslai, bad u la ong ba un sa ïap.
Kumta u la khot ïa ki lok jong u baroh bad u la ong ha ki, “Ki khmat jong nga kim ïohthiah shuh bad ngam don pyrthei shuh ba lyng-a mynsiem.
Nga la ong ha lade, ‘Ka apot aïu kaba kat kane ïa nga ! Ha ka umsaw bah aïu kaba kat kane ïa nga la phyrnop ! Nga uta u basbun bad uba la ju ieid haba nga khlaiñ bor.’

Mynta te nga kynmaw ïa ki jingsniew baroh ba nga la leh ha Jerusalem. Nga la kurup lut ïa ki khiew ki pliang rupa bad ksiar jong ka, bad nga la phah pynïap ïa ki trai shnong ka Judea khlem don daw ei ei.
Nga tip ba dei na kane ba kine ki jingjynjar baroh ki la wan lap halor jong nga. Ani wow, nga ïap da ka jingkhuslai ka bakhraw ha ri nongwei.”
Te kumta u la khot ïa u Philip, uwei na ki lok jong u, bad u la pynlong ïa u u nongsynshar halor ka hima jong u baroh.
U la ai ha u ïa ka pansngiat, ïa ka barandi syiem jong u bad ïa ka sahti mohor, ba un dup hikai ïa u Antiokhus u khun jong u, bad un dup pynsan pynrangbah ba un long syiem.
Kumta u syiem Antiokhus u la ïap hangta ha ka snem 149 [163 SK].

U Lisias u tang shu tip ba u syiem u la ïap, u la thung ïa u Antiokhus u khun jong u syiem, ban synshar. Dei u Lisias uba la pynsan pynrangbah ïa u naduh dang khynnah, bad u la ai kyrteng ïa u, u Eupator.
Te ki briew kiba ha ka kut shnong ki la khem ïa ki Israel thrait shi thrait baroh sawdong ka tempyl. Ki la pyrshang har rukom ban pynsniew ïa ki bad ban pynkhlaiñ ïa ki Jentil.
Kumta u Judas u la raikut ban pynjot ïa ki, bad u la lum lang ïa ki paid baroh ban kerkut ïa ki.
Ki la ïalang baroh bad ki la kerkut ïa kata ka kut shnong ha ka snem 150 [162 SK]; u la tei ki kut thma kiba kynjang bad kiwei pat ki kor thma.
Hynrei la don ki briew kiba la ïoh phet na kata ka jingkerkut bad la don ruh ki Israel shet kylla kiba la leit ryngkat bad ki.
Ki la leit ïathuh ïa u syiem, “Sa katno ngi dang dei ban ap ba phin leh ïa kaba dei hok bad pynhiar kput ïa ki para jait jong ngi?
Ngi la long ki basuk ban shakri ïa u kpa jong phi, ban leh katba u ong bad ban bud ïa ki hukum jong u.

Na kane ka daw ki khun ki kti jong ki para jait jong ngi ki la kerkut ïa ka kut shnong bad ki la kylla ki nongshun jong ngi; nalor nangta ki la pynïap kat ïa kiba ki la ïoh kem, bad ki la knieh jubor ïa ki hok pateng jong ngi.
Ym dei tang ïa ngi ba ki la kner kti pyrshah, hynrei wat ïa ki khyndew baroh lin kiba khappud ïa ki.
Hakhmih mynta kumne ki la ker tawiar ïa ka kut shnong kaba ha Jerusalem ban knieh ïa ka; ki la lah pynkhlaiñ da ki kut ïa ka tempyl bad ïa ka Beth-Zur;
te lada phim khanglad kloi ïa ki, kin dang leh kiei kiei kiba kham khraw, bad phin ym lah shuh ban pynsangeh ïa ki.”
U syiem u la bitar eh lep haba u la ïohsngew ïa kane. U la khot lang ïa ki lok jong u baroh, ïa ki rangbah duh jong ki kynhun shipai bad ïa ki rangbah pyrton kulai.
Sa ki shipai wer nong ki la wan ïasnoh kti bad u na kiwei pat ki hima bad na ki dewlynnong duriaw.
Haba kheiñ ïa ki shipai jong u, ki la don shispah hajar ki shipai kjat, arphew hajar ki pyrton kulai, bad laiphew-ar tylli ki hati kiba la mlien ïaleh thma.

Kine ki la wan lyngba ka Idumea bad ki la shong dara pyrshah ka Beth-Zur, bad bun sngi ki la ïaleh bad ki la tei ïa ki kor thma, hynrei ki Ju ki la tur thrait thrait, ki la thang ïa ki da ka ding, bad ki la ïaleh da ka jingshlur.
Te u Judas u la kynran na ka kut shnong bad u la shong dara ha Beth-Zekharia, mar pyrshah ka jaka dara u syiem.
Dang step phyrngab u syiem u la khie bad u la pynïaid jubor ïa ki shipai jong u da ka lynti kaba sha Beth-Zekharia; hangta ki shipai jong u ki la pynkhreh ïaleh bad ki la put ïa ki turoi.
Ki la pyni ha ki hati ïa ka um soh kriep bad soh lyngdkhur, ban pynshongshit thma ïa ki.

Ki la bate ïa kita ki mrad mar shikynhun kynhun; bad uwei uwei u hati ki la buh shihajar ngut ki shipai kiba kieng da ki jynphong nar, bad kiba phong da ki tupia rnong; bad sa sanspah ngut ki pyrton kulai ki bakynsai ha man la uwei pa uwei u mrad.
Kine ki la shim jaka kat haba don uta u mrad; kat shaba leit ma u ki la leit ryngkat bad u, bad kim ju ieh noh ïa u.

Halor ki hati la don ki kut dieng kiba khlaiñ bad kiba da tap; ïa kine la teh pynskhem halor uwei pa uwei u mrad da u jynpynboh u bakyrpang, bad ha kawei kawei la don saw ngut ki ’riewthma kiba ïaleh nangta, bad nangta la don sa u mahut nong India uba ñiah.
Ïa kiwei pat ki nongshong kulai la buh baroh arliang, ha ki krung baroh ar jong ka kynhun shipai, ban pynsatia ïa u nongshun, katba ïa ki pat de la ïada da ki kynhun ba ïeng syndait.
Haba ka sngi ka la tyngshaiñ halor ki stieh kiba da ka ksiar bad ka rnong, ki lum ki la phyrnai bad ki thaba kum ki musa ding.
Te shi bynta na ka kynhun shipai u syiem ka la saphret sha ki lum kynjang, bad kiwei pat katto katne ki shipai ki la don ha them madan; ki la ïaid pyn-eh ryntih shriak.

Baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa na uta u paid byllien, na ka jingïaid kyrdem jong uta u paid bad ïa ka jingriew ki tiar thma jong ki, ki la khynñiuh, namarba kata ka kynhun shipai ka la long ka bakhraw bad ka bakhlaiñ shibun.
Hynrei u Judas bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la tur sha ka thma, bad hynriewspah ngut na ka kynhun shipai u syiem ki la kyllon.
U Eleasar, ïa uba la sin Abaran, u la ïohi ba ïa uwei u mrad la pynriam da ki atiar syiem. U la long u bakham kynjang ban ïa kiwei pat, bad u la tharai ba u syiem u la don halor jong u.
Kumta u la ai ïa la ka jingim ban pyllait ïa ki paid lajong bad ban ïoh nam ïa lade junom.
U la tur dukhi hapdeng ki shipai ba ïeng syndait ban dup poi sha u; u la pynïap ïa ki briew sha kamon sha kadiang, bad ki la pyllait lynti hakhmat jong u baroh arliang.
U la poi haduh hapoh uta u hati, u la tynrah ïa u na shapoh, bad u la pynïap ïa u; hynrei u hati u la kyllon khru ha madan halor jong u, bad hangta ha shen une u la ïap.
Haba ki Ju ki la ïohi ïa ka bor syiem bad ïa ka jingtur dukhi jong kita ki shipai, ki la phai dadien ban phet ïap.
Ki shipai u syiem ki la leit tur sha Jerusalem pyrshah ïa ki, bad u syiem u la shong dara ha Judea bad ha Lum Zion.
U la ïasuk bad ki nong Beth-Zur, bad ki la mih noh na shnong, namarba kim don jynbam shuh ban ïashan ïa ka jingkerkut, ba dei artat ka snem sabath jong kata ka ri.
Kumta u syiem u la jop ïa ki Beth-Zur bad u la buh karod ban ap ïa ka.
Nangta ki la shong dara hakhmat ka tempyl bun sngi. U la pynïeng ki ïingkut ki bakynjang, ki kor thma ban kawang ding bad maw, ki kor ban siat khnam, bad ki batul.
Ki Ju ruh ki la thaw ki kor thma kiba kum ki jong ki, bad ki la ïaleh bun sngi.
Hynrei kim don jynbam ba la kynshew, namarba dei ka snem ka bahynñiew; kito ki Jentil kiba la wan rieh ha Judea ki la bam lut phoiñ ïa ki jynbam ba la kynshew.
Tang khyndiat ngut ki la sah ha ka tempyl namarba la khie ka ’nemsniew, bad kiba dang sah ki la ïasaphret sha la ki jaka jaka.
Te u Lisias u la ïohsngew ba u Philip, ïa uba u syiem Antiokhus u la aiti mynba u dang im ban sumar ïa u khun jong u u Antiokhus haduh ba un da long syiem,
u la wan phai na Persha bad Media ryngkat bad ki shipai kiba la leit bad u syiem, bad ba u la pyrshang ban knieh ïa ka bor pynïaid ïa ki kam hima sima.

Mar kumta u la ai hukum ban mih, bad u la ong ha u syiem, ha ki rangbah duh jong ki pyrton shipai, bad ha ki shipai, “Ngi nangtlot man ka sngi, ka jynbam ruh ka la duna, ka kut ba ngin kerkut ruh ka bakhlaiñ, bad ki kam hima sima ki nangbán khia tyngeh tyngeh halor jong ngi.
To ngin ïakren bha noh bad kine ki briew, bad ngin ïasuk ïasaiñ bad ki lem bad ka jait bynriew jong ki baroh.
To ngin shah ba kin im katkum ki aiñ jong ki kumba ki la ju leh mynshuwa; namar dei na ka daw ba ngi la pynduh ïa ki aiñ jong ki ba ki sa bitar bad ki sa leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh.”
Kata ka jingkren ka la pynsngewbha ïa u syiem bad ïa ki rangbah shipai, bad u la phah sha ki Ju ka jingtyrwa ïasuk bad ki la pdiang ïa ka.
Kumta u syiem bad ki jarnel ki la kular artat. Tang ynda la leh ïa kane, ki Ju ki sa mih noh na ka kut.

Hynrei ynda u syiem u la rung ha u lum Zion bad u la ïohi ba kata ka jaka ka la long shisha ka kut ka bakhlaiñ, u la pynkheiñ ïa la ka juban ba u la kular, bad u la ai hukum ban pynpra ïa ka kynroh baroh sawdong.

Nangta u la leit noh kyrkieh kyrkieh bad u la leit phai sha Antiokh. U la shem ba u Philip u la pynïaid ïa kata ka nongbah, hangta u la ïaleh ïa u da ka thma, bad u sa ïoh knieh ïa kata ka nongbah da ka bor.
Ha ka snem 151 [161 SK], u Demetrius u khun jong u Seleukus, u la mih na Rome, u la wan da ka lieng bad khyndiat ngut ki briew sha kawei ka nongbah harud duriaw, bad u la sdang ban synshar hangta.
Katba u dang rung ha ka ïing syiem jong ki kpa tymmen jong u, ka kynhun shipai ka la kem ïa u Antiokhus bad ïa u Lisias ban wan ïalam ïa ki sha u.
Hynrei ynda u la tip ïa kata, u la ong, “Wat pyni ïa ki khmat jong ki ha nga!”
Kumta ki shipai ki la shu pynïap ïa ki, bad u Demetrius u la kiew khet ha ka hima jong u.
Te hangta la wan sha u baroh ki ’riewbe-aiñ bad ki ’riewpohjait jong ka Israel; ïa ki la ïalam da u Alsimus uba la kwah ban long lyngdoh rangbah.
Ki la wan mudui kumne ha u syiem pyrshah ïa ki paidbah, “U Judas bad ki para jong u ki la pynïap ïa ki lok jong phi baroh, bad ki la beh noh ïa ngi na ka ri jong ngi.

Te mynta to phah seh ïa u briew uba phi shaniah; ieh une un leit peit hi ïa ka jingjot baroh ba u Judas u la pynngat halor jong ngi bad halor ka ri jong u syiem, bad to un pynshitom ïa ki bad ïa kito baroh kiba ïarap ïa ki.”
Kumta u syiem u la jied ïa u Bakkhides, uwei na ki lok jong u syiem, u lat jong ka jylla shalyndet ka Wah Ïuphratis; u la long u kynja bakhraw ha ka hima bad u bangeit syiem.
Te u la phah ïa une bad u Alsimus ’riewpohjait, ïa uba u la thung lyngdoh rangbah. U la hukum ïa u ban pynhiar kput halor ki khun Israel.
Kumta ki la wan sia bad ki la poi ha ri Judea bad ka kynhun shipai ka bakhraw. U la phah ki nongrah khubor sha u Judas bad ki para jong u da ki ’tiensuk ’tiensaiñ hynrei ki bashetkylla.
Kita kim shym salia ïa ki ktien jong ki, namar ki la ïohi ba ki la wan bad ka kynhun shipai ka bakhraw.
Te shikynhun ki rangbah ’riewsaid ki la wan paw lang hakhmat u Alsimus bad u Bakkhides ban kylli shaphang ki jingïakut.
Ki Hasidean ki la long ki banyngkong napdeng ki khun Israel ban wad jingsuk na ki,
naba ki la ong, “U lyngdoh na ka jait u Aron u la wan bad ka kynhun shipai, bad un ym leh sniew ei ei ïa ngi.”
U la kren ki ktien suk suda ha ki bad u da kular artat ha ki, “Ngin ym wad ban pynmynsaw ïa phi ne ïa ki lok ki jor jong phi.”
Kumta ki la shaniah ïa u, hynrei u la kem hynriewphew ngut na ki bad u la pynïap ïa ki ha ka shisngi, katkum ka ktien ba la thoh,
“Ïa ka doh jong ki ’riewkhuid jong Me bad ïa ka snam jong ki ki la theh kylleng sawdong ka Jerusalem, bad ym shym don mano mano ban tep ïa ki.”
Te ki paidbah baroh ki la tieng bad ki la sngewtriem ïa ki, naba ki la ong, “Kim bat satia ïa ka jingshisha bad ïa ka hok, namarba ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jingïakut, wat ïa ka jingkular lajong.”

Te u Bakkhides u la mih na Jerusalem bad u la shong dara ha Beth-Zeth. U la phah kem ïa ki briew shibun bah kiba la phet noh na u, bad katto katne ngut ruh na ki paidbah, bad u la pynïap ïa ki, nangta u sa bret ïa ki hapoh kawei ka thliew.
U la buh ïa u Alsimus ban peit ïa ka ri bad u la ai shipai ruh kiban ïarap ïa u; hadien kata u Bakkhides u la leit phai sha u syiem.
U Alsimus u la ïaleh tyngeh ban dup long lyngdoh rangbah,
bad kynja kiba pyndik ïa ki paidbah ki la leit ïalang lok bad u. Ki la ïoh bor halor ka ri Judea bad ki la pynjot shibun ïa ka Israel.
U Judas u la ïohi ïa ka jingsniew baroh ba u Alsimus bad kito kiba don bad u ki la leh hapdeng ki khun Israel; ba ka la palat wat ïa kaba la leh da ki Jentil.
Kumta u Judas u la leit kylleng sawdong ka Judea, u la pynhiar kput halor kito kiba la phet noh, bad u la khang lad ïa kito kiba don hapoh ka nongbah ban leit sha nongkyndong.

Haba u Alsimus u la ïohi ba u Judas bad kito kiba don bad u ki la nangkhlaiñbor, bad u la sngewthuh ba un ym lah ïashan pyn-eh bad u, u la leit phai sha u syiem bad u la leit rah ki jingmudui ki barunar pyrshah ïa ki.
Kumta u syiem u la phah ïa u Nikanor, u kynja rangbah u bapawnam, uba isih tyngeh tyngeh ïa ki Israel, bad u la ai hukum ïa u ban pynjot ïa ki paidbah.
Kumta u Nikanor u la wan sha Jerusalem bad ka kynhun shipai ka bakhlaiñ, bad da kaba shetkylla u la phah kane ka khubor ïasuk sha u Judas bad ki para jong u,
“Keiñ noh ban ïaleh thma hapdeng jong nga bad jong phi; ngan sa wan bad khyndiat ngut ki briew ban ïakynduh markhmat bad phi da ka jingsuk jingsaiñ.”
Kumta u la wan sha u Judas bad ki la ïakhublei uwei ïa uwei pat kumba ïasuk eh. Phewse u nongshun u la pynkhreh ban kem bor ïa u Judas.
U Judas u la ïoh jingtip ba u Nikanor u la wan sha u da ka jingmut arsap, kumta u la tieng ïa u bad um treh shuh ban ïakynduh bad u.
Haba u Nikanor u la sngewthuh ba ïa ka buit jong u la tip, u la leit ban ïaleh da ka thma ïa u Judas hajan Kapharsalama.
Kumba sanspah ngut ki briew na ka kynhun shipai u Nikanor ka la kyllon, bad kiba sah ki la her raimaw raidieng sha ka nongbah u Dabid.

Hadien kine ki jingjia u Nikanor u la leit kiew sha u Lum Zion. Don ki lyngdoh kiba la mih na ka tempyl, don ruh ki tymmen ki san u paidbah, ban ai khublei ïa u da ka jingsuk jingsaiñ, bad ban pyni ha u ïa ka jynkñia thang ba la tyrwa na ka bynta u syiem.
Pynban u la kynteit ïa ki bad u la rkhie beiñ, u la bynthiew ïa ki bad u la kren kob,

bad ha ka jingbitar u la kular artat, “Lymda nga ïoh hi ïa u Judas bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ha ki kti jong nga ha kane ka khep, lada nga wan phai suk, ngan thang duh ïa kane ka ïing.” Bad u leit bak da ka jingbitar ka bakhraw.
Hadien kata ki lyngdoh ki la leit rung, bad da kaba ïam ki la ïeng hakhmat ka duwan bad ka tempyl, ki la ong,
“Me la jied ba yn khot ïa kane ka ïing da ka kyrteng jong Me, ba kan long na ka bynta ki paid jong Me, ka ïing jingduwai bad jingnguh jingdem.
To pynhiar kput halor une u briew bad ka kynhun shipai jong u, to ai ba kin kyllon da ka waitlam; to kynmaw ïa ki jingbeiñ blei jong ki, wat ai kin dang im shuh.”
Te u Nikanor u la mih na Jerusalem bad u la shongdara ha Beth-horon, bad ki pyrton Siria ki la wan ïasynrop lang bad u.
U Judas u la shongdara ha Adasa lem bad laihajar ngut ki briew. Te u Judas u la duwai bad u la ong,
“Mynba ki nongrah khubor na u syiem ki la kren beiñ blei u angel jong Me u la leit pom pynïap shispah phraphew san hajar ngut ki Assiria.

Te to ïuh roit mynta ka sngi ruh ïa kane ka kynhun shipai hakhmat jong ngi; ai ba kiwei pat kin ïoh jingsneng ba u Nikanor u la kren sang ïa ka tempyl jong Me, bad to bishar ïa u katkum ka jingdakaid jong u.”
Kumta ki kynhun shipai ki la ïakynduh ha ka thma ha ka sngi ka bakhatlai jong u ’nai Adar. Ka kynhun shipai u Nikanor ka la shah rem thiaw, bad ma u u la long u banyngkong ban kyllon ha ka thma.
Haba ka kynhun shipai jong u ka la ïohi ba u Nikanor u la kyllon, ki la bret ïa ki tiar ïapom bad ki la phet bak.
Ki Ju ki la thwet nadien jong ki shi sngi lynti, naduh Adasa shaduh Gasara, bad katba ki nangthwet katta ki nangput ïa ka hukum thma da ki turoi.

Te la mih ki briew na ki nongrit kylleng sawdong ka Judea, bad ki la ïaleh narud narud ïa ki nongshun, haduh ba kine ki hap phai dien sha ki nongbeh. Kumta baroh ki la kyllon da ka waitlam, khlem sah shuh wat uwei ruh.

Te ki Ju ki la ïoh knieh ïa ki mar kliarwait bad ïa ka jinglute, nangta ki la khet ïa ka khlieh jong u Nikanor bad ïa ka kti kamon jong u kaba u la talaiñ sarong; ki la wan rah ïa kine bad ki la sieh pynïohi ïa ki shabar ka Jerusalem.
Ki paidbah ki la risa haduh katta katta, bad ki la pynlong ka sngi leh kmen kaba khrawbah khrawsan.
Ki la rai ba ïa kane ka sngi dei ban leh burom man la ka snem ha ka sngi ka bakhatlai jong u ’nai Adar.
Kumta ka ri Judea ka ïoh jingsuk katto katne por.
Te u Judas u la ïohsngew ïa ka nam jong ki Roman, ba ki long ki bakhlaiñ bad kiba leh sbun ïa kito kiba ïateh lok bad ki, ba ki kular ban ïadei lok bad kito kiba leh jan bad ki,
namarba ki long ki badonbor. Ki briew ki la ïalap shaphang ki thma jong ki bad ki kam shlur ba ki la leh hapdeng ki nong Kallia, kumno ki la jop ïa ki bad ki la pynbor ïa ki ban siew khajna;
shaphang ki jingleh jong ki ha ri Speiñ ban ïoh dakhol ïa ki par rupa bad ki par ksiar hangta;

nangta shaphang kumno ki la ïoh synshar ïa kata ka ri baroh kawei da ka jingdukhi bad ka jingdohsnieh, wat la kata ka ri ka jngai shibun na ka ri jong ki. Ki la pyndem wat ïa ki syiem kiba la wan pyrshah ïa ki naduh bakut ka pyrthei, bad kine ki la shah ïuh roit ha ki haduh ba kin da lanot khait da ka jingjynjar; kiwei pat ki la siew khajna ha ki.
Ïa u Philip, ïa u Perseus syiem ka Masedonia, bad ïa kiwei pat kiba la ïeng pyrshah ïa ki, ki la ïuh roit ha ka thma bad ki la jop.

Ki la jop ruh ïa u Antiokhus Bakhraw, u syiem ka Asia, uba la leit ban ïaleh thma ïa ki da ki shispah arphew tylli ki hati, da ka kynhun ki pyrton kulai, da ki kali thma bad da ka kynhun shipai ka bakhraw. Ki la thom lin ïa u;

ki la kem im ïa u bad ki la rai ba ma u bad kito kiban synshar pateng hadien jong u ki dei ban siew ka khajna ka bakhia, ki dei ban ai ki koidi jamin bad ban aiti noh ïa ki katto katne ki jylla ki babha tam,
ïa ka ri India, Media bad Lidia. Ki la knieh ïa kine na u bad ki la ai ha u syiem Eumenes.
Ki Grik ki la pynkhreh ban wan pynjot ïa ki,

hynrei ki tang shu tip liak ïa kata, ki la phah uwei u jarnel pyrshah ïa ki Grik bad u la ïaleh ïa ki. Bun bah na ki ki la mynsaw bad ki la kyllon, bad ki Roman ki la kem koidi ïa ki tnga bad ki khun jong ki. Ki la kurup ïa ki, ki la jop ïa kata ka ri, ki la pyntwa ïa ki kut jong ki, bad ki la teh mraw ïa ki haduh mynta mynne.
Ïa ki hima kiba dang sah bad ïa ki dewlynnong, kat kiba la ïeng pyneh ïa ki, ki la pynjot bad ki la pynlong mraw;

hynrei ïa ki lok jong ki bad ïa kito kiba shaniah ha ki ki la pynskhem ïa ka jingïadei lok. Ki la pyndem ïa ki syiem kiba hajngai bad kiba hajan, bad kat kiba la bna ïa ka nam jong ki ki la tieng burom ïa ki.
Ïa kito kiba ki kwah ban ïarap bad ban pynlong syiem, ki la pynlong syiem, ïa kito pat ba ki kwah ban pynhiar khet, ki la pynhiar khet; kumta ïa ki la kyntiew nam haduh katta katta.
Pynban nalor katne ym shym don uwei na ki uba la phong ka pansngiat ne kup ka banat saw kum ka dak ka jingsarong,
hynrei ki la tei na ka bynta ïalade ka ïing dorbar, bad man la ka sngi laispah arphew ngut ki dkhot dorbar ki ïatai nia lyntertait shaphang ki paidbah khnang ban dup synshar bha ïa ki.

Ki pynkhamti ha uwei u briew man la ka snem ban synshar halor jong ki, bad ban pynïaid ïa ka ri jong ki baroh kawei; ki kohnguh ïa uta uwei u briew, bad ym ju don ka jingpihuiñ ne ka jingïabishni hapdeng jong ki.
Kumta u Judas u la jied ïa u Eupolemus, u khun u Ïoannis, u khun u Akkos, bad ïa u Jason u khun u Eleasar, bad u la phah ïa ki sha Rome ban pynskhem ïa ka jingdei lok bad ka jingïateh jutang,
bad ban pyllait ïa lade na ka lyngkor, naba ki la ïohi ba ka hima ki Grik ka la teh mraw nadong shadong ïa ki Israel.
Kine ki la leit sha Rome, ka lynti leit ka bajngai, bad ynda ki la rung hapoh ka ïing dorbar, ki la kren kumne:

“U Judas, ïa uba la sin kyrteng u Makabeus, bad ki para jong u lem bad ki paid Ju baroh, ki la phah ïa ngi sha phi ban pynskhem ïa ka jingïateh lok bad ka jingsuk bad phi, khnang ba yn dup ñiew ïa ngi kum ki lok ki jor jong phi.”
Kata ka jingtyrwa ka la pynsngewbha ïa ki.
Kane harum ka nokol jong ka shithi ba ki la thoh kum ka jubab, ha ki lyngkniap rnong, bad ki la phah sha Jerusalem ba kan sah bad ki hangta kum ka jingkynmaw ïa ka jingsuk bad ka jingïateh lok:
“To kan wan ka jingmanbha ïa ki Roman bad ïa ka jait bynriew Ju ha duriaw bad ha ryngkew shi junom. To kin jngai na ki ka waitlam bad u nongshun.
Lada ka thma ka wan nyngkong sha Rome ne sha kano kano na ki lok jong ki ha ka hima jong ki baroh,
ka jait bynriew Ju kan leh kumba ka dei ïa ki lok da ka dohnud baroh, katba shah ka kam ban leh.
Ïa u nongshun uba ïaleh thma kin ym dei ban ai ne ban phah jynbam, tiar ïapom, tyngka pisa ne lieng, kumba ka Rome ka la rai; ki dei ban rakhe ïa ka jingteh ïakut khlem da ap ban ïoh bainong ei ei.
Ha kajuh ka rukom, lada ka thma ka wan nyngkong ha ki Ju, ki Roman kin leh da ka mon sngewbha kum ïa la ki lok, katba shah ka kam ïa ki ban leh.
Ïa ki nongshun yn ym bit ban ai jynbam, tiar ïapom, pisa tyngka ne lieng, kumba ka Rome ka la rai. Ki dei ban bat ïa kine ki jingteh ïakut bad kin pyndep ïa ki khlem jingshukor.
Kumta halor kine ki jingteh ïakut ki Roman ki pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad ki paidbah Ju.

Ynda kine ki jingïakut ki la trei kam, baroh arliang kin ïarai lada dang donkam ba yn pyndap shuh ne ba yn pynduh noh ei ei; kin leh ïa kata katba ki sngewbit hi, bad kata ka jingpyndap ne ka jingpynduh ba ki leh kan teh.
“Te shaphang ki kam bymdei ba u syiem Demetrius u la leh ïa ki, ngi la thoh kumne sha u, ‘Balei phi la pynkhia ïa ka lyngkor jong phi halor ki Ju kiba long ki lok kiba ïateh jutang bad ngi?
Lada ki dang pan jingïarap biang pyrshah ïa phi, ngin sa ïada ïa ki hok jong ki bad ngin ïaleh ïa phi ha duriaw bad ha ryngkew.”

Haba u Demetrius u la ïohsngew ba u Nikanor bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la rem ha ka thma, u la phah sa shisien ïa u Bakkhides bad ïa u Alsimus sha ri Judea ryngkat bad ki pyrton kamon jong ka kynhun shipai jong u.
Ki la leit da ka lynti kaba leit sha Gilgal bad ki la shong dara marpyrshah ka Mesaloth ha Arbela; ki la ïoh knieh ïa ka bad ki la pynïap bun ki briew.
Ha u bnai u banyngkong jong ka snem 152 [160 SK] ki la shong dara ha marpyrshah Jerusalem;
nangta ki la ïaid bak bak haduh ban da poi ha Berea lem bad arphew hajar ngut ki shipai kjat bad arhajar ki pyrton kulai.
U Judas pat u la shong dara ha Elasa bad laihajar ngut ki ’riewïaleh ki bakynsai.
Haba ki la ïohi ïa ki shipai nongshun byllien bah, ki la sheptieng shibun eh, bad bun ki la phet noh na ka jaka dara, haduh ba wat phraspah ngut ki briew ruh kim don shuh.
Haba u Judas u la ïohi ba ka kynhun shipai jong u ka la phet bad sa ka thma ruh ka la jan, u la jew sew ka mynsiem, naba um don por shuh ban lum lang ïa ki.
U la noh mynsiem, hynrei u la ong ha kito kiba dang sah, “Ïa ngin mih la ka mih ban leit ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong ngi. Lehse ngi lah ban ïa aireng bad ki.”

Hynrei ki la pyrshang pynkohnguh ïa u ban ieh noh noh, “Ngin ym lah. To ngin shu ïaphet noh mynta ban pyllait im ïa lade, bad ieh ngin sa wan biang bad ki hynmen ki para jong ngi ban ïaleh ïa ki; ngi khyndiat briew eh.”

Hynrei u Judas u la phai ktien, “Da lei lei ngim dei ban leh kumta ban phet ïap na ki. Lada la poi ka ïá jong ngi, ieh ngin ïap da ka jingshlur na ka bynta ki para jait jong ngi, bad wat ai daw ba yn thad ïa ka burom jong ngi.”

Te ka kynhun shipai u Bakkhides ka la mih buk na ka jaka dara bad ka la ïeng pynkhreh ban ïaleh. Ïa ka kynhun ki pyrton kulai la phiah ar pyrton, ki nongkawang maw bad ki nongsiat khnam ki la ïaid shakhmat jong ka kynhun shipai, kumba leh ki ’riewthma ki bakynsai.

U Bakkhides u la don bad ka kynhun kaba ha kamon. La ker na krung da ki ar pyrton, ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la tur shaphrang tang shu put ïa ki turoi; ki briew kiba don bad u Judas ruh ki ïatur mar ïaput turoi.
Ka khyndew ka la khynwin ir da ka jingsawa ki pyrton thma, bad ka thma ka la neh naduh dang step haduh ynda premmiet.
U Judas u la ïohi ba u Bakkhides u la don sha kamon bad ki pyrton ki bakhlaiñ; te kumta baroh ki ’riewdohsnieh ki la leit bad u.
Ki la thom lin ïa ka pyrton ba ha kamon, bad u la beh nadien ïa ki haduh Lum Asotus.
Haba kito kiba don bad ka kynhun ba ha kadiang ki la ïohi ba ka kynhun ba ha kamon ka la rem, ki la phai bad ki la beh sia nadien u Judas bad ki briew jong u.
Ka la long ka thma kheiñ duh, bad shibun ki la mynsaw bad ki la kyllon na baroh arliang.
U Judas ruh u la kyllon, bad kiwei pat ki la phet ïap.
Kumta u Jonathan bad u Simon ki la shim ïa la u hynmen bad ki la tep ïa u ha ka jyntep ki kpa tymmen jong ki ha Modeiñ,
bad ki la ïam na ka bynta jong u. Baroh shi Israel ki la bynñiaw jur na ka bynta jong u; ki la ïam briew bun bun sngi bad ki la ong,
“Kumno u bakhlaiñ bor u la kyllon, u nongpyllait im jong ki Israel!”
Te ïa kiwei pat ki kam jong u Judas, ïa ki thma bah jong u, bad ïa ki kam shlur ba u la leh ym shym la buh jingkynmaw namarba ki la bun eh.
Hadien ka jingïap u Judas, ki ’riewbe-aiñ ki la khie khlieh na ki dong baroh jong ka Israel; baroh ki ’riewpohjait ki la wan paw pyrthei.
Ha kito ki sngi la khie ka ’nemsniew ka bashyrkhei, bad ki para ri ki la phet lang bad ki sha ki nongshun.
U Bakkhides u la jied ïa ki ’riew khlem blei bad u la phah peit ha ki ïa ka ri.
Ki la ïit bad ki la wad ïa ki lok jong u Judas, bad ki la wan ïalam ïa ki sha u Bakkhides, bad une pat u la pynhiar kput halor jong ki bad u la pynjah burom ïa ki.
Kumta la don ka jinglanot ka bakhraw ha Israel, kaba ym pat ju don naduh kito ki por ba ki nongïathuhlypa kim shym don shuh hapdeng jong ki.
Te kumta ki lok baroh jong u Judas ki la ïakynduh lang bad ki la ong ha u Jonathan,

“Naduh ba ïap u hynmen jong phi u Judas, ym shym don shuh uwei ruh uba kum ma u ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong ngi bad ïa u Bakkhides, bad ban leh ei ei ïa kito ki para ri jong ngi kiba shun ïa ngi.
Mynta ka sngi te ngi la jied ïa phi ban shim ïa ka jaka jong u kum u nongsynshar bad u nongïalam jong ngi, ban ïaleh ïa ka thma jong ngi.”
U Jonathan u la pdiang ha kata ka por ïa ka jinglong nongïalam, bad u la shim ïa ka jaka jong u hynmen jong u, u Judas.
U Bakkhides u tang shu bna ïa kane, u la wad ban ïoh pynïap ïa u.
Hynrei u Jonathan bad u Simon u para jong u lem bad kito kiba ïadon bad u ki la ïohsngew ïa kata, bad ki la phet bak sha ri kynjah Tekoa bad ki la shong dara harud ka pung Asphar.
U Bakkhides u la bna ïa kane ha ka sngi sabath, kumta ma u bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la kam sha shiliang ka Jordan.

Te u Jonathan u la phah ïa u para jong u, u Ïoannis, kum u nongïalam ki paidbah bad u la kyrpad ïa ki nong Nabat, kiba long ki lok jong u, ba kin shah ban pynsumar ma ki ïa ki jynkit jynbah jong ki kiba don shibun bah.
Hynrei ki khun jong u Jambri na Medeba ki la wan mih bad ki la kem ïa u Ïoannis bad ki la knieh jubor ïa kiei kiei baroh katba u don, nangta ki la phet bak bad kita ki mar.

Hadien kane ka jingjia, la leit ïathuh ha u Jonathan bad u Simon u para jong u, “Ki khun u Jambri ki ïapynlong ka jingïapoikha ka bakhraw, bad ki ïalam ïa ka nongïapoikha, ka khun uwei u ’riewkhraw uba na Kanaan, na Nadabath bad shibun ki nongbud.”
Hangta ki la kynmaw khlek ïa ka snam u Ïoannis u para jong ki, bad ki la leit kiew soit na ka lyngngop lum.

Ki la ’mied ïa la ki khmat bad ki la peit, ki la ïohi u paid byllien bah uba ïaiaid da ka jingïahalla bad shibun ka jynkit; u nongïapoikha pat u la wan mih bad la ki lok bad ki hynmen ki para jong u ban shaw da ki ksing ki dhah, da ka put ka tem bad ki tiar thma.

Markumta ki la tur kynsan ïa ki na ka jaka ap bad ki la sdang ban pom pynïap ïa ki. Bun ki la mynsaw bad ki la kyllon, kiwei pat ki la her ïap sha u lum; hangta kine ki la ïoh shim lut ïa ki mar jong ki.
Kumta, kata ka jingïapoikha ka la kylla ka jingïam briew, bad ka sur jong ki nongrwai ka la kylla long ka jingrwai myllung haba tep briew.
Ynda ki la ïoh pynhiar kput haban da biang na ka bynta ka snam u para jong ki, ki la wan phai sha ki bir bah ka Jordan.
Haba u Bakkhides u la ïohsngew ïa kata, u la wan ha ka sngi sabath shaduh rudwah Jordan.
Te u Jonathan u la ong ha kito kiba ïadon bad u, “Ïeng triang mynta ban ïaleh na ka bynta ka jingim lajong, naba mynta ka sngi kiei kiei kim long kum mynshuwa.
Ha peit ! Ka thma hakhmat jong ngi bad hadien jong ngi; ka um jong ka Jordan sha kane ka liang bad shatai, sa ka ahor ktieh bad ka ’lawbniap: ym don jaka satia ban phai.
To kyang mynta sha Bneng ba phin dup lait na ki kti jong ki nongshun jong ngi.”
Kumta la sdang ka thma, bad u Jonathan u la kner ïa la ka kti ban pom ïa u Bakkhides, hynrei une u la lait da ka said bad u la phet shadien.
Te u Jonathan bad ki briew jong u ki la ryngkoh hapoh ka Jordan bad ki la jngi shaduh sha shiliang, hynrei ki nongshun kim shym kam sha shiliang ka Jordan ban ïaleh ïa ki.
Antad shihajar ngut ki briew u Bakkhides ki la kyllon ha kata ka sngi.

Te u Bakkhides u la wan phai sha Jerusalem bad u la tei ki nongbah ki bakhlaiñ ha Judea: ka kut ha Jerikho, ha Emmaus, ha Beth-horon, ha Bethel, ha Timnath, ha Pharathon, bad ha Tephon, bad ki kynroh ki bakynjang, ki khyrdop bad ki nar khang.
U la buh hangta ki pyrton ban pynsaja ïa ki Israel.
U la pynkhlaiñ ruh ïa ki nongbah Beth-Zur bad Gasara, bad ïa ka kut shnong, bad ha kita ki shnong u la buh ki shipai bad ki jynbam jyndih.
Ïa ki khun shynrang jong ki kynja riewkhmat jong ka ri u la shim ban pynlong koidi jamin, bad u la buh ïa ki ha ka karod jong ka kut kaba ha Jerusalem.
Ha u bnai u ba-ar jong ka snem 153 [159 SK], u Alsimus u la ai hukum ban pyntwa ïa ka kynroh jong ka phyllaw ka bashapoh jong ka tempyl. U la pynpra ïa ka jyntrei jong ki nongïathuh lypa!”

Hynrei haba u la sdang pyntwa ïa ka, u Alsimus u la kem pang kynsan kynsan ha kata ka por bad ka kam jong u ka la sangeh; la set sbak ka shyntur jong u bad u la long kumba ïap, haduh ba um lait kren shuh wat shikyntien ruh ban ai hukum shaphang ka ïing jong u.
Kumta u Alsimus u la ïap da ka jingkordit ka bakhraw ha kata ka por.
Haba u Bakkhides u la tip ba u Alsimus u la ïap, u la leit phai sha u syiem, bad ka ri Judea ka la ïoh jingsuk kumba ar snem.

Te ki ’riewbe-aiñ ki la ïasylla sniew, ki ong, “ha peit! U Jonathan bad ki briew jong u ki la shongsuk bad ki la sngewshngaiñ. Kumta ïa ngin ïaleit khot biang ïa u Bakkhides, ba un kem ïa ki baroh ha ka shimiet.”
Shisha ki la ïaleit bad ki la ïapyrkhat buit bad u.

Katba u dang mih ban wan bad ka kynhun shipai ka bakhraw, u la phah jar jar ki shithi sha ki lok ki jor jong u baroh ha Judea, u ong ïa ki ban kem ïa u Jonathan bad ïa ki briew jong u; hynrei ki khlem lah ban leh ïa kata, namarba la lah tip ïa ka buit jong ki.
Ki briew jong u Jonathan ki la kem kumba sanphew ngut ki briew kiba long ki nongïalam ha kane ka jingshet kylla ha Judea, bad ki la pynïap ïa ki.
Hadien kata u Jonathan bad ki briew jong u, ryngkat bad u Simon ki la leit phet sha Beth-Basi ha ri kynjah. U la tei biang ïa ki kynroh kiba la pynpra, bad ki la pynkhlaiñ ïa ka.
Haba u Bakkhides u la tip ïa kata, u la lum lang ïa ki bor thma jong u baroh bad u la pynmih hukum sha ki briew ka Judea.
Nangta u la wan bad u la ker tawiar ïa ka Beth-basi; u la ïaleh ïa ka bun sngi, bad u la thaw ruh ki kor thma.
Hynrei u Jonathan u la ieh noh ïa u Simon u para jong u hapoh shnong, ïa lade u la leit sha ki shnong kyndong; u la leit tang bad khyndiat ngut ki briew.
U la pom ïap ïa u Odomera bad ïa ki para jong u bad ïa ki khun shynrang u Phasiron ha ki ïing jaiñ jong ki.
Nangta u la sdang ban tur bad ban ïaleh thma da ki shipai jong u; u Simon pat bad ki briew jong u ki la tur kynsan napoh shnong bad ki la wiang ding ïa ki kor thma.
Ki la ïaleh bad u Bakkhides bad ki la thom lin ïa u. Ki la pynsasti ïa u khait, naba ka jingthmu bad ka jinghiar thma jong u ki la pulom.
Kumta u la khie bitar ir ïa ki ’riewbe-aiñ kiba la aibuit ïa u ban wan rung hapoh ka ri, bad u la pynïap bun na ki. Nangta u la rai ban leit noh sha la ka ri.
Haba u Jonathan u la tip ïa kane, u la phah ki nongrah khubor sha u ban ïasuk ïasaiñ bad u, bad ban pynphai noh ïa ki koidi.
U la mynjur, bad u la leh kumba u la ong; u la kular ha u Jonathan ba un ym pyrshang shuh ban leh sniew ïa u katba u dang im.
U la pynphai sha u ïa ki koidi ba u kem mynshuwa na ri Judea; nangta u sa leit phai noh sha la ka ri, bad um shym wan shuh artat sha ka ri jong ki.
Kumta la kut ka thma ka wait ha Israel. Te u Jonathan u la shong shnong ha Mikhmash. U Jonathan u la sdang ban bishar ïa ki paidbah, bad u la pynduh jyndam ïa ki bakhlem blei na Israel.
Ha ka snem 160 [152 SK], u Aleksander Epiphanes, u khun jong u Antiokhus, u la wan hiar bad u la dakhol ïa ka Ptolemais. Ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa u, bad u la sdang ban synshar hangta.
Haba u syiem Demetrius u la ïohsngew ïa kata, u la lum ka kynhun shipai ka baheh shibun bad u la mih ban ïaleh thma ïa u.
Te u Demetrius u la phah sha u Jonathan ka shithi kaba tang ki ktien suk suda ban burom ïa u;
naba u la ong, “To ngin ïasuk noh bad u, shuwa ba un ïasuk bad u Aleksander pyrshah ïa ngi,
haba u kynmaw ïa ki kam sniew baroh kiba ngi la leh ïa u, ïa ki para jong u bad ïa ka jait bynriew jong u.”
Kumta u Demetrius u la ai bor ïa u Jonathan—kum ïa u lok jong u—ban buh shipai bad ban ai tiar thma ïa ki; u la ai hukum ba dei ban aiti noh ha u ïa ki koidi jamin kiba don ha ka kut shnong.
Te u Jonathan u la wan sha Jerusalem bad u la pule ïa kata ka shithi ha ba ïohsngew ki paidbah baroh bad ki briew kiba la don ha ka kut shnong.
Ki la sngewtieng her tang shu ïohsngew ba u syiem u la ai bor ïa u ban buh shipai.
Ki briew kiba ha ka kut shnong ki la aiti ïa ki koidi jamin ha u Jonathan, bad une pat u la pynphai ïa ki sha ki kmie ki kpa jong ki.
Te u Jonathan u la shong la sah ha Jerusalem bad u la sdang ban tei biang bad ban pynbha ïa ka nongbah.
U la phah nongtrei ban pynïeng ïa ki kynroh bad ban tawiar ïa u lum Zion da ki maw ki basawdong, ban khlaiñ bha ka kut; ki ruh ki la leh kumta.
Ki nongwei nong-ar pat kiba la don ha ki kut ba la tei u Bakkhides ki la phet noh;
uwei pa uwei u la mih na la ka jaka shong bad u la leit noh sha ka ri lajong.
Tang ha Beth-Zur la sah katto katne kiba la lyndet ïa ka aiñ bad ki hukum, naba ka la long kum ka jakarieh.

Te u syiem Aleksander u la ïohsngew ïa ki jingkular baroh ba u Demetrius u la phah sha u Jonathan, bad ki briew ki la ïathuh ïa u shaphang ki thma ba u Jonathan bad ki para jong u ki la ïaleh, shaphang ki kam shlur ba ki la leh, bad shaphang ki jingjynjar ba ki la shah.
Kumta u la ong, “Hato ngin dang ïoh uwei pat u briew uba kum ma u ? Ale mynta, ngin ïapynlong ïa u u lok u jor jong ngi.”
Te u la thoh shithi bad u la phah ïa ka sha u, da kine ki ktien harum:
“U syiem Aleksander ha u para jong u u Jonathan, ka jingkhublei.
Ngi la ïohsngew shaphang jong phi, ba phi long u ’riewthma u bakhlaiñ bad u babit ban long u lok jong ngi.

Kumta ngi la thung ïa phi mynta ka sngi ban long u lyngdoh rangbah jong ka jait bynriew jong phi; ïa phi yn khot u lok jong u syiem” (u la phah ïa u ka jaiñkup banat bad ka pansngiat ksiar); “phi dei ban ïashah bad ngi bad ban ïateh lok bad ngi.”
