Kumta u Jonathan u la phong ïa ki jaiñ leh niam ki bakhuid ha u bnai bahynñiew jong ka snem 160 [151 SK], ha ka jingkhawai niam ki tabernakyl, nangta u la buh shipai bad u la pynriam ïa ki da ki tiar thma shikatdei.
Haba u Demetrius u la bna ïa kine kiei kiei u la diaw bad u la ong,
“Kaei kane ba ngi la leh ? U Aleksander u la kloi shwa ïa ngi ban ïateh lok bad ki Ju ban pynkhlaiñ ïa lade.
Nga ruh ngan sa thoh sha ki ki ktien pynshngaiñ bad ngan sa kular ka burom bad ki jynai sngewbha, ba ngan dup ïoh lem ka jingïarap.”
Kumta u la phah ka khubor sha ki da kum kine ki ktien: “U syiem Demetrius sha ka jait bynriew Ju, ka jingkhublei.
Namarba phi la bat ïa la ka jutang bad ngi, bad phi la ïaineh ban long lok bad ngi, khlem da ïashah liang bad ki nongshun jong ngi, ngi la ïohsngew ïa kata da ka jingkmen.
Te mynta to ïaineh ban shaniah ha ngi, bad ngin sa siew pyllait ïa phi da ka jingbha na ka bynta kata kaba phi leh ïa ngi.
Ngin sa pyllait ïa phi na bun ki jingteh bad ngin sa ai ruh ïa phi ki jynai sngewbha.
“Te mynta nga pyllaitluid ïa phi bad ngam teh shuh ïa ki Ju baroh ban siew ïa ka khajna, ïa ka musur mluh bad ïa ki bainguh syiem.

Ha ka jaka ban khrong ïa ka balai na u kew bad ïa ka bashiteng na u soh jong ki dieng ba nga dei ban ïoh, nga pyllait ïa kine naduh mynta ka sngi bad hadien habud. Ngan ym khrong ïa ki na ri Judea ne na ki lai tylli ki distrik, kiba snoh lang bad ka na Samaria bad Galilea, naduh mynta ka sngi bad shi junom.
Ai ba ka Jerusalem bad ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ka, kiba ju siew ïa ka bashiphew bad ki khajna jong ka, kin lait na ka khrong ka pynshok.
Nga ieh noh noh ïa ka bor ban pynïaid ïa ka kut shnong kaba ha Jerusalem bad nga aiti ïa ka ha u lyngdoh rangbah, ba un dup buh ha ka ki briew kiba u mon hi ban ap karod.

Ïa uwei pa uwei u koidi Ju uba na ri Judea ba la kem na kano kano ka bynta jong ka hima jong nga, nga ai jinglaitluid khlem da siew ei ei; ai ki rangbah hima baroh kin pynduh noh ïa kano kano ka jynkhrong na ki jynri jyndup jong ki.

“Ai ba ki jingkhawai niam bad ki sabath baroh, ki ’naithymmai bad ki sngi ba la buh ïá, ki laisngi shuwa ka jingkhawai niam bad ki laisngi hadien ka jingkhawai niam—kin long ki sngi jinglaitluid bad jingpyllait ïa ki Ju baroh kiba ha ka hima jong nga.
Yn ym don mano mano uba ïoh bor ban dawa ei ei na ki ne ban pynsatia ïa ki shaphang kano kano ka kam.
“Ai ba ki Ju kin rung kam shipai ha ka kynhun u syiem haduh laiphew hajar ngut briew, bad ai ba ka jingkyrshan ïa ki kan long kumba ju leh lem ïa ki shipai baroh jong u syiem.

Ai ba yn buh katto katne na kine ha ki kut ki bakhraw jong u syiem, bad ai ba katto katne ngut na ki kin don ha ki kam jong ki ’riewshaniah ha ka hima. Ai ba ki rangbah bad ki nongïalam kin long na ki hi, bad ai kin im katkum ki aiñ lajong, thik kumba u syiem u la hukum ha ri Judea.

“Shaphang kito ki distrik lai tylli ba la pynsnoh lang bad ka Judea na ri Samaria, ieh kin sah lang bad ka Judea ba yn dup ñiew ïa ki hapoh uwei u nongshynshar, bad ba kim dei ban kohnguh ïa kano kano kawei pat ka bor hynrei tang ïa u lyngdoh rangbah.
Ïa ka Ptolemais bad ïa ka khyndew kaba ïasoh lang bad ka, nga la ai sngewbha ha ka tempyl ha Jerusalem, ba kan siew ïa ki jynlut jynsep kiba donkam jong ka tempyl.
Nga ai ruh khatsan hajar shekel ka rupa shisnem shisnem na ki jynïoh jong u syiem kiba wan na ki jaka ba la mang.
Ïa kiwei pat ki jynkynshew kiba ki rangbah sorkar kim pat siew kumba ki la ju leh ha ki snem ba la dep, kin ai noh naduh mynta barabor na ka bynta ka jinglehniam ha ka tempyl.

Nalor nangta, ïa ki sanhajar shekel ka rupa kiba ki rangbah sorkar ki ju ïoh man la ka snem na ki jynïoh haba leh niam ha ka tempyl, ïa kine ruh la pynduh, namarba ki dei ki jong ki lyngdoh kiba shakri hangta.

Uno uno uba wan rieh ha ka tempyl ha Jerusalem, ne ha kano kano ka jaka jong ka kaba la ker (namarba u kit ram ha u syiem ne u don kano kano ka kam), ieh un lait noh bad un ïoh biang ïa la ka spah ka hajar ha ka hima jong nga.
“Ïa ka bailut ban tei biang bad ban maramot ïa ka tempyl ieh yn siew na ka pla pisa jong u syiem.
Ïa ka bailut ban tei biang ïa ki kynroh ka Jerusalem bad ban pynkhlaiñ ïa ka baroh sawdong, bad ïa ka bailut ban tei biang ïa ki kynroh ha Judea, ieh yn siew ïa kine ruh na ka pla pisa jong u syiem.”

Haba u Jonathan bad ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien, kim ngeit bad kim pdiang ïa ki, namarba ki la kynmaw bha ïa ki jingleh sniew ki bakhraw kiba u Demetrius u la leh ha Israel bad katno u la bánbeiñ sohsat ïa ki.
Ki la sngewbha ïa u Aleksander, namarba u la long u banyngkong ban kren ki ’tiensuk ’tiensaiñ, te kumta ki la neh ki lok jong u katba u dang im.
Te u syiem Aleksander u la lum lang shikatdei bah ki shipai ki swar bad u la shong dara marpyrshah u Demetrius.
Kine ki syiem ar ngut ki la ïakynduh ha ka thma; ka kynhun shipai u Demetrius ka la phet ïap, bad u Aleksander u la beh ïa u nadien bad u la jop ïa ki.
U la ïaleh sa ïaleh tyngeh haduh ba ynda sep ka sngi, bad u Demetrius u la kyllon ha kata ka sngi.
Te u Aleksander u la phah ki nonglamktien syiem sha u Ptolemi u syiem Ijipt da kane ka khubor,

“Namarba nga la wan phai sha ka hima jong nga bad nga la shong halor ka khet jong ki kpa tymmen jong nga, bad nga la pynskhem artat ïa ka bor syiem jong nga—naba nga la jop ïa u Demetrius bad nga la ïoh synshar hi ïa la ka ri;
nga la ïaleh ïa u da ka thma, bad ngi la jop thiaw ïa u bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u, bad ngi la ïoh ban shong halor ka khet jong ka hima jong u—

te, kumta to ngin pynskhem ïa ka jingïadei lok markylliang; phi ai ha nga mynta ïa ka khun jong phi ban long ka tnga jong nga, nga hangta ngan long u pyrsa kurim jong phi, bad ngan ai ha phi bad ha ka ki jynai sngewbha kiba kat ka kyrdan jong phi.”
U syiem Ptolemi u la jubab da kaba ong, “Suk kata ka sngi ha kaba phi la wan phai sha ka ri jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad phi la ïoh ban shong halor ka khet jong ka hima jong ki.
Te mynta ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi kumba phi la thoh, hynrei to wan ïakynduh ïa nga ha Ptolemais, ba ngin dup ïa-ithuh uwei ïa uwei pat, bad ngan long u kthaw kurim jong phi, kumba phi la ong.”
Kumta u Ptolemi u la mih na Ijipt, ma u bad ka Kleopatra ka khun jong u, bad ki la wan sha Ptolemais ha ka snem 162 [150 SK].

U syiem Aleksander u la ïakynduh ïa u, bad u Ptolemi u la ai ïa la ka khun ka Kloepatra ban ïapoikha bad u, bad u la leh burom ïa ka jingïapoikha jong ka ha Ptolemais da ka jingiphuh iphieng ka bakhraw kumba ju leh ki syiem.
Te u syiem Aleksander u la thoh sha u Jonathan ban wan ïakynduh ïa u.
Kumta u la leit da ka main bakhraw sha Ptolemais bad u la ïakynduh ïa kita ki syiem ar ngut; u la ai ïa ki ka rupa bad ka ksiar bad bun ki jynai sngewbha, kumta u la ïoh ïa ka jingñiew burom bad ki.
Shikynhun ki ’riewpohrati na Israel, ki ’riewbe-aiñ, ki la ïasylla lang pyrshah ïa u ban kynnoh sniew ïa u; hynrei u syiem um shym patiaw ei ei ïa ki.
U syiem u la ai hukum ban loit noh ïa ki jaiñphong jong u Jonathan bad ban pynkup ïa u da ka banat basaw, bad ki la leh kumta.

U syiem u la pynshong ruh ïa u marsyndah jong u; u la ong ha ki rangbah syiem, “Khie lang bad u shapdeng shnong bad to pynbna ba ym bit mano mano ban wan mudui ei ei pyrshah ïa u shaphang kano kano ka kam, bad ym bit mano mano ban thlia ïa u na kano kano ka daw.”
Te haba ki nongmudui jong u ki la ïohi ïa ka burom ba la ai ha u, katkum ka jingpynjari, bad ki la ïohi ruh ba la pynkup ïa u da ka banat saw, ki la shu phet noh.
Kumta u syiem u la ai burom ïa u bad u la thoh kyrteng ïa u hapdeng ki lok ki bakynsai duh jong u, bad u la pynlong ïa u u rangbah shipai duh bad u lat jong ka jylla.
Te nangta u Jonathan u la wan phai sha Jerusalem ha ka jingsuk bad ka jingkmen.
Ha ka snem 165 [147 SK], u Demetrius u khun jong u syiem Demetrius, u la wan na Krit sha ka ri jong ki kpa tymmen jong u.
Haba u syiem Aleksandar u la ïohsngew ïa kata, u la diaw shibun bad u la wan phai sha Antiokh.

U Demetrius u la thung ïa u Apollonius ban long u lat jong ka Selesiria, bad u la lum shibun bah ki shipai, nangta u la shong dara ha marpyrshah Jamnia. Hadien kata u la phah kane ka khubor harum sha u Jonathan lyngdoh rangbah:
“Dei tang ma phi uban ïeng pyrshah ïa ngi, bad nga la shah kynshi bad shah kynkok na ka daw jong phi. Balei sha phi leh rangbah pyrshah ïa ngi ha ri lum?
Lada phi sngewshngaiñ ha la ki shipai ki swar, ale sha madan ban ïakynduh ïa ngi, bad to ngin ïamad bor uwei ïa uwei pat hangthie; nga te nga don ka bor jong ki nongbah bad nga.

Ha da kylli ban dup tip nga nga dei uei bad kiei kiwei pat kiba ïarap ïa ngi. Ki briew kin ïathuh ba phin ym lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ngi, naba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la shah pynher krad na ka ri lajong.
Te mynta phin ym lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa u pyrton kulai jong nga bad ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba kat kane ha ka madan, ha kaba ym don maw ne mawria, ne jaka ban phet.”

Haba u Jonathan u la ïohsngew ïa kita ki ktien jong u Apollonius, ka mynsiem jong u ka la khih her. U la jied shiphew hajar ki briew bad u la mih na Jerusalem; u Simon u para jong u pat u la leit ïakynduh ïa u ban ïarap ïa u.
U la shong dara ha marpyrshah Joppa, hynrei ki trai shnong ki la khang ïa ki khyrdop jong ka, namarba u Apollonius u la don pyrton shipai ha Joppa.
Kumta ki la ïaleh ïa ka bad ki briew kata ka shnong ki la tieng her bad ki la plie ïa ki khyrdop, bad kumta u Jonathan u la ïoh dakhol ïa ka Joppa.

Haba u Apollonius u la ïohsngew ïa kata, u la lum laihajar ngut ki pyrton kulai bad ka kynhun shipai ka baheh, nangta u la leit sha Asotus la kumba leh mynleh leit shaphrang. Ha kajuh ka por u la leit shaduh ka ri madan, naba u la don shibun bah ki pyrton kulai bad u la sngewshngaiñ ba don ma ki.
U Jonathan u la beh ïa u nadien sha Asotus bad ki kynhun shipai ki la ïakhun thrait.
U Apollonius pat u la lah buhrieh shihajar ki pyrton kulai hadien jong ki.

U Jonathan u la sngewthuh ba la ap thap ïa u nadien namarba ki la lah ker tawiar ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u bad ki la siat ïa ki briew jong u da ki khnam naduh dang step phyrngap haduh ynda jan sepsngi.
Hynrei ki briew jong u ki la ïeng skhem, kumba la hukum u Jonathan, bad ki kulai u nongshun ki la thait.
U Simon pat u la phah tur shakhmat ïa ki shipai jong u, bad u la ïa-aireng bad ki pyrton kulai kiba la thait; ki la shah thom lin ha u bad ki la phet.
Ka pyrton kulai ka la sapra ha ri madan. Ki la phet sha Asotus bad ki la rung ha Beth-dagon, ka tempyl u blei thaw jong ki, ban ïoh rieh.
Hynrei u Jonathan u la thang ïa ka Asotus bad ïa ki shnong kiba sawdong, bad u la kurup ïa ki; ïa ka tempyl u Dagon bad ïa kito kiba leit rieh ha ka u la thang da ka ding.
Haba kheiñ ïa kito kiba la kyllon da ka waitlam, bad kito kiba shah thang im, ki la long haduh phra hajar ngut ki briew.
Te u Jonathan u la mih nangta, bad u la shong dara ha marpyrshah Askalon, bad ki trai shnong ki la mih ban leit tan ïa u da ka jingleh burom ka bakhraw.
U Jonathan bad ki briew kiba don bad u ki la wan phai sha Jerusalem bad shikatdei ka mar kliarwait.
Haba u syiem Aleksander u la ïohsngew ïa kine kiei kiei, u la nang burom shuh shuh ïa u Jonathan.
U la phah ha u uwei u panpoh ksiar, kumba ju long ka dustur ban ai ïa ki kur ki jait syiem. U la ai ei ruh ha u ïa ka Ekron bad ïa ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ka.
Te u syiem Ijipt u la lum u paid shipai u bakhraw, la kat u shyiap harud duriaw, bad shibun ki lieng; bad u la pyrshang ban ïoh dakhol ïa ka hima u Aleksander da ka buit tuh ban pynïar ïa la ka hima.

U la mih ban leit sha Siria da ki ’tiensuk suda, bad ki paidbah jong ki shnong ki la plie ïa la ki khyrdop ha u bad ki la leit shaw ïa u, naba u syiem Aleksander u la hukum ïa ki ban leit tan ïa u, ba u dei u kthaw kurim jong u Aleksander.
Pynban haba u Ptolemi u la rung ha kita ki shong u la buh shikynhun ki shipai ha kawei kawei ka shnong.

Haba u la wan hajan Asotus, ki la pyni ha u ïa ka tempyl u Dagon ba la thang, ïa ka Asotus bad ïa ki nongrit jong ka ba la pynjot, ïa ki metïap kiba thiah kylleng kylleng, bad ïa ki met ba ingkhong jong kito ïa kiba u Jonathan u la thang ha ka thma, naba ki la kynton thup ïa ki ha ka lynti ba u ïaid.
Ki la ïathuh ruh aïu u Jonathan u la leh, ban tei pap ha u; hynrei u syiem u la shu sngap tlip.
U Jonathan u la leit ïakynduh ïa u syiem ha Joppa da ka maiñ bakhraw, bad ki la ïa ai khublei markylliang, ki la ïasah miet artat hangta.
Te u Jonathan u la leit bad u syiem shaduh ka wah ba khot Eleutherus; nangta u la wan phai sha Jerusalem.
Kumta u syiem Ptolemi u la ïoh synshar ïa ki shnong harud duriaw haduh Seleusha kaba hajan duriaw, bad u ïaithaw buit sniew pyrshah ïa u Aleksander.

U la phah ki nonglamktien sha u syiem Demetrius, u ong, “Ale, to ngin ïateh lok markylliang, bad ngan ai kurim ha phi ïa ka khun jong nga kaba long ka tnga jong u Aleksander, bad phin sa ïoh ban synshar halor ka hima u kpa jong phi.
Naba nga la babe kylla mynta ba nga la ai ha u ïa la ka khun, na ka daw ba u la thap ban pynïap ïa nga.”
U la tei pap halor u Aleksander namarba u la ikwah ïa ka hima jong u.
Kumta u la shim noh ïa la ka khun na u bad u la ai ïa ka ha u Demetrius. U la pynjngai bak ïa lade na u Aleksander, bad la paw tyngkreiñ ka jingïashun jong ki.
Te u Ptolemi u la rung ha Antiokh bad u la phong ïa ka pansngiat jong ka Asia. Kumta u la phong ar tylli ki pansngiat halor ka khlieh jong u, ka pansngiat jong ka Ijipt bad jong ka Asia.
Ha kata ka por u syiem Aleksander u la don ha Silisha, namarba ki briew jong kata ka thaiñ ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u.
Haba u Aleksander u la ïohsngew ïa kata, u la wan tur pyrshah ïa u da ka pyrton thma. U Ptolemi ruh u la mih, u la ïakynduh ïa u da ka kynhun shipai ka bakhlaiñ, bad u la pynher krad ïa u.
Kumta u Aleksander u la phet sha Arabia ban rieh hangta, bad u syiem Ptolemi u la ïoh nam.
U Arab, ba kyrteng u Zabdiel, u la mait ïa ka khlieh jong u Aleksander bad u la phah ïa ka sha u Ptolemi.
Hynrei u syiem Ptolemi u la ïap lai sngi hadien, bad ïa ki shipai jong u kiba ha ki kut la pynïap da ki trai shnong kiba la don ha ki kut hi.
Kumta u Demetrius u la long syiem ha ka snem 167 [145 SK].
Ha kito ki sngi u Jonathan u la lum lang ïa ki briew ka Judea ban ïaleh ïa ka kut shnong ha Jerusalem, bad u la tei shibun ki kor thma ban pyndonkam pyrshah ïa ka.
Hynrei katto katne ngut ki ’riewbe-aiñ kiba la shun ïa la ka jait bynriew, ki la leit ïathuh ha u syiem ba u Jonathan u la kerkut ïa ka kut shnong.

U tang shu ïohsngew ïa kata u la bitar, u la mih mar mar, bad u la poi ha Ptolemais. U la thoh sha u Jonathan ban ym kerkut shuh hynrei ban wan ïakynduh ïa u ban ïashong dorbar ha Ptolemais kloi katba lah.

Haba u Jonathan u la ïohsngew ïa kane, u la ai hukum ban kerkut la ka kerkut. Nangta u la jied katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san ka Israel bad katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh, bad u la phah khnang ïa lade ha ka jingsyier,
naba u la leit sha u syiem ha Ptolemais. U rah artat ka rupa, ka ksiar, ki jaiñphong bad bun kiwei pat ki kynja jynai sngewbha. Te u la pynsngewbha ïa u.
Wat la ki ’riewbe-aiñ katto katne ngut kiba dei ki para jait jong u ki la ïaimudui pyrshah ïa u,
u syiem u la leh ïa u kumba la leh lem kiwei pat ki syiem kiba ha shuwa jong u; u la kyntiew burom ïa u hakhmat ki lok jong u baroh.
U la pynskhem ïa u kum u lyngdoh rangbah bad ha ki kyrdan baroh ba u la don mynshuwa, bad u la rai ba yn ñiew ïa u kum u lok bakyrpang jong u.
Te u Jonathan u la kyrpad ïa u syiem ban pyllait khajna ïa ka Judea bad ïa ki lai tylli ki distrik ha Samaria, bad u la kubur ban ai ïa u laispah talen.
U syiem u la kohnguh, bad u la thoh ka shithi sha u Jonathan shaphang kine kiei kiei baroh; ka jynthoh ka la long kumne:
“U syiem Demetrius ha u Jonathan u para jong u bad ha ka jait bynriew Ju, ka jingkhublei.
Ïa ka nokol jong ka shithi kaba ngi la thoh shaphang jong phi ha u Lasthenes, u kur jong ngi, ngi la thoh sha phi ruh, khnang ba phin dup tip aïu ka ong.
‘U syiem Demetrius ha u Lesthenes u kpa jong u, ka jingkhublei.
Ha ka jait bynriew Ju, kiba long ki lok jong ngi bad kiba pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki ïa ngi, ngi la rai ban leh bha, namarba ki la pynpaw ïa ka mon babha sha ngi.

Ngi la pynskhem ba kin ïoh ïa ka ri Judea bad ïa ki lai tylli ki distrik Aphairema, Lidda bad Ramathaim, ïa kine, lang bad ki thaiñ kiba khap-pud bad ki, la pynsnoh bad ka Judea na Samaria. Ïa kito baroh kiba tyrwa jingkñia ha Jerusalem, ngi la pyllait na ki baikhrong syiem kiba u syiem u ju ïoh mynshuwa na ki man la ka snem, na ki jynthung jyntep jong ka khyndew bad na ki soh ki pai jong ki dieng.

Naduh mynta ngi pyllait noh ïa ki na kiwei pat ki jingsiew kiba ngi dei ban ïoh na ka bashiphew, ki jynkhrong kiba dei ki jong ngi, bad ki jynkhrong kiba ngi dei ban ïoh na ki par mluh bad na ka bai nguh syiem.
Wat ïa kawei na kine ki jingshah sngewbha ym dei ban pynduh naduh mynta shi junom.
Te kumta, to sumar ba yn thoh nokol ïa kane, bad sa ai ïa ka ha u Jonathan, bad sa buh ïa ka ha ka jaka ka bashynna bha ha u lum bakhuid.’ ”

Te haba u syiem Demetrius u la ïohi ba ka ri ka la suk la saiñ hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u, bad ba ym don jingpyn-eh shuh ïa u, u la phah noh ïa ki shipai jong u baroh, uwei pa uwei u briew sha la ka jaka jaka, lait tang ïa ki shipai nongwei kiba u la khot bylla na ki dewlynnong ri nongwei. Kumta ki shipai kiba la shakri ïa ki kpa tymmen jong u ki la isih ïa u.

Te la don u Tripho uba la long mynshuwa uwei na ki nongkyrshan jong u Aleksander. U la ïohi ba ki shipai ki la khñium pyrshah ïa u Demetrius. Kumta u la leit sha u Arab uba kyrteng u Imalkue, uba la sumar sukher ïa u Antiokhus u khun rit jong u Aleksander,

bad u la bán tyngeh ïa u ban ai noh ha u ïa u Antiokhus, ba un dup long syiem ha ka jaka u kpa jong u. U la ïathuh ruh ha u Imalkue ïa ka jingleh u Demetrius bad ïa ka jingisih jong ki shipai ki swar ïa u Demetrius; u la sah hangta bun sngi.
Te u Jonathan u la phah ka jingkyrpad sha u syiem Demetrius ban weng noh ïa ki shipai jong ka kut shnong na Jerusalem, bad ïa ki shipai kiba ha kiwei ki kut, na ka daw ba ki ïai ïaleh ïa ki Israel.

Te u Demetrius u la phah kane ka khubor sha u Jonathan, “Ym tang ba ngan leh ïa kine kiei kiei na ka bynta jong phi, bad ka jait bynriew jong phi hynrei ngan dang ai burom shuh shuh ïa phi bad ïa ka jait bynriew jong phi, nga tang shu ïoh kabu ei ei.
Te mynta, phin da leh bha shisha lada phi phah briew kiban ïarap ïa nga, namarba ki shipai jong nga baroh ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga.”
Kumta u Jonathan u la phah sha u laihajar ngut ki ’rangïaleh ha Antiokh, bad ki tang shu poi sha u syiem, u syiem u la shadkmen ba ki la wan poi.
Te ki briew jong kata ka nongbah ki la lum hapoh shnong, haba kheiñ haduh shispah arphew hajar ngut, bad ki la kwah ban pynïap ïa u syiem.
Hynrei u syiem u la phet sha la ka ïingdulan. Hangta kita ki briew ki la knieh ïa ki surok bah jong ka nongbah bad ki la sdang ban ïaleh.
Kumta u syiem u la khot ïa ka jingïarap jong ki Ju bad ki la leit ïarap ïa u bad ki la saphriang kylleng kata ka nongbah. Ki la pynïap ha kata ka sngi haduh shispah hajar ki briew.
Ki la wiang ding ïa ka nongbah, bad ki la ïoh knieh shikatdei ka mar kliarwait ha kata ka sngi, kumta ki la pyllait-im ïa u syiem.
Haba ki briew jong kata ka shnong ki la ïohi ba ki Ju ki la ïoh synshar katba ki mon, ki la tieng bad ki la kyang sha u syiem da kane ka jingkyrpad,
“To ai jingsuk ïa ngi, bad phah ïa ki Ju ban ym ïaleh shuh ïa ngi bad ïa ka nongbah jong ngi.”

Te ki la bret ïa la ki tiar thma bad ki la ïasuk. Kumta ki Ju ki la ïoh burom hakhmat jong u syiem bad jong ki briew baroh ha ka hima jong u, nangta ki sa wan phai noh sha Jerusalem bad ka mar kliarwait shikatdei.
Kumta u syiem Demetrius u la shong halor ka khet jong ka hima jong u, bad ka ri ka la suk biang hapoh ka jingshynshar jong u.
Hynrei u la pynkheiñ ïa la ka juban ba u la kular; u la leh jngai na u Jonathan bad um shym la siewkylliang ïa ki jingleh bha ba u Jonathan u la leh ïa u, pynban u la bánbeiñ tyng-eh ïa u.
Hadien kane u Tripho u la wan phai lem bad u khynnah Antiokhus, uba la sdang ban synshar bad u la phong ka pansngiat syiem.
Baroh ki shipai kiba u Demetrius u la phah noh ki la ïasnoh bad u, bad ki la ïaleh thma ïa u Demetrius; une u la phet bad u la shah rem.
U Tripho u la ïoh kem ïa ki hati bad u la ïoh bat ïa ka Antiokh.

Te u khynnah Antiokhus u la thoh kumne sha u Jonathan, “Nga pynskhem ïa phi ha ka jinglong lyngdoh rangbah, nga thung rangbah ïa phi halor ki saw tylli ki distrik, bad nga pynlong ïa phi uwei na ki lok jong u syiem.”
Te u la phah sha u ka pliang ksiar bad ki tiar jynbam jyndih, bad u la ai ïa u ka hok ban dih na ki khuri ksiar, ban riam da ka banat basaw bad ban kieng ïa u panpoh ksiar.
Ïa u Simon u para jong u u la thung lyngskor naduh Ladder kaba ha Tirus shaduh khap-pud Ijipt.

Te u Jonathan u la mih bad u la leit jingleit shalyndet ka Wah sha ki nongbah hangta, bad ka kynhun shipai Siria baroh kawei ka la ïateh lok lang bad u. Haba u la poi ha Askalon, ki briew kata ka shnong ki la wan shaw ïa u bad ki la leh burom ïa u.
Nangne u la leit sha Gaza, hynrei ki nong Gaza ki la khang lynti ïa u. Kumta u la kerkut ïa ka, u la thang da ka ding ïa ki nongrit jong ka bad u la kurup ïa ki.

Hangta ki nong Gaza ki la nguh la dem ïa u Jonathan, u la ïasuk bad ki, hynrei u la shim kum ki koidi jamin ïa ki khun rangbah jong ki nongsynshar jong ki bad u la phah ïa ki sha Jerusalem. Nangta u la ïaid lyngba ka ri shaduh Damaskus.
Te u Jonathan u la ïohsngew ba ki rangbah shipai u Demetrius ki la wan tur sha Kadesh ha Galilea da ka kynhun thma ka baheh da ka jingmut ban weng noh ïa u na ka kam.
Te u la leit ban ïaleh ïa ki, hynrei u la ieh noh ïa la u para u Simon ha la ka ri.
U Simon u la shong dara ha pyrshah Beth-Zur bad u la ïaleh ïa ka la bun sngi bad u la tawiar ïa ka.
Hangta ki la pan ïasuk bad u, bad u ruh u la leh kumta. U la pynmih ïa ki na kata ka jaka, u la dakhol ïa ka nongbah, bad u la buh u pyrton shipai ban ap ïa ka.
U Jonathan bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la shong dara hajan ka Pung Gennesaret. Dang step phyrngap ki la leit tur sha madan Hazor,
bad ka kynhun shipai ki nongwei ka la wan tur sha u ha madan. Kine ki la buh ka kynhun kaba ap thap ïa u ha lum, katba ma ki ïa lade ki la tur markhmat.
Hangta ki briew kiba ap thap ki la mih bluit na ki jaka jong ki bad ki la ïaleh thma.
Ki briew u Jonathan baroh phar ki la phet; ym shym sah shuh wat uwei ruh, lait tang u Matathias u khun jong u Absalom, bad u Judas u khun jong u Khalphi, ki rangbah shipai.
U Jonathan u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ, u la ber da u khyndew ïa la ka khlieh, bad u la duwai.
Nangta u la phai biang sha ka thma pyrshah ïa u nongshun, u la pynliem ïa ki bad ki la phet.
Haba ki briew jong u kiba dang phet ki la ïohi ïa kane, ki la wan phai sha u bad ki la ïasoh lang bad u ban beh nadien shaduh Kadesh, sha ka jaka dara jong ki; bad hangta ki la shong dara.
Haduh laihajar ngut ki nongwei ki la kyllon ha kata ka sngi. Nangta u Jonathan u la wan phai sha Jerusalem.
Te u Jonathan u la ïohi ba la biang ka kabu ïa u, kumta u la jied ki briew bad u la phah ïa ki sha Rome ban pynskhem bad ban pynthymmai ïa ka jingïalong lok bad ki.
U la phah shithi ruh da kajuh ka jingthmu sha ki Sparta bad sha kiwei pat ki jaka.

Kumta ki la leit sha Rome bad ki la rung ha ka ïing dorbar, ki ong, “U Jonathan lyngdoh rangbah bad ka jait bynriew Ju ki la phah ïa ngi ban pynthymmai ïa ka jingïadei lok bad ka jingïateh jutang bamynshuwa jong phi bad ki.”
Ki Roman ki la ai shithi ha ki briew man la ki jaka, da kaba kyrpad ïa kine ba kin pyllait lynti ïa ki nonglamktien ba kin dup ïaid suk sha ri Judea.
Kane ka long ka nokol jong kata ka shithi kaba u Jonathan u la thoh sha ki Sparta:
“U Jonathan lyngdoh rangbah, ka dorbar jong ka ri, ki lyngdoh, bad kiwei pat ki paidbah Ju sha ki hynmen ki para jong ki ki Sparta, ka jingkhublei.
Naduh mynshuwa eh la phah ka shithi sha u Onias lyngdoh rangbah na u Arius uba la long u syiem jong phi, u da ong ba phi long ki hynmen ki para jong ngi, kumba ka paw na ka shithi ba la pynsnoh lang.
U Onias u la pdiang sngewbha ïa u nonglamktien da ka burom, bad u la pdiang ïa ka shithi, kaba la pyntip shai ïa ka jingïateh jutang bad ka jingïadei lok.
Te namarkata, wat la ngim donkam ïa kine kiei kiei, namar ngi don ka jingpynshngaiñ na ki kitab bakhuid kiba ngi don ha ki kti jong ngi,

lajar katta ngi la rai hi ban phah pynthymmai ïa ka jingïadei shipara bad ka jingïalong lok jong ngi bad phi, khnang ba ngin ym ïalong mynder bad phi, namarba ka la slem jlang ka por naduh ba phi la phah ïa ka shithi jong phi sha ngi.

Ngi te ngi kynmaw kyndiang barabor ïa phi man ka teng, ha ki jingkhawai niam jong ngi bad kiwei pat ki sngi kyrpang ba la buh, ha ki jingkñia ba ngi tyrwa bad ha ki jingduwai jong ngi, namar ka long ka bahok bad ka badei ban kynmaw ïa la ki hynmen para.
Ngi da sngewkmen shibun ha ka burom jong phi.
Hynrei ngi te ïa lade, bun tang ki jinglanot suda bad ki thma kiba la ker tawiar ïa ngi; ki syiem kiba don sawdong ïa ngi ki la ïaleh thma ïa ngi.
Ngim shym kwah ban pynsalia ïa phi bad ïa kiwei pat ki lok ki jor jong ngi na ka bynta kine ki thma,
namarba ngi don ka jingïarap kaba wan na Bneng ban kynpham ïa ngi; ngi la lait na ki nongshun jong ngi, bad ki nongshun jong ngi ki la shah rem.

Namarkata ngi la jied ïa u Numenius u khun jong u Antiokhus, bad ïa u Antipater u khun jong u Jason, bad ngi la phah ïa ki sha Rome ban pynthymmai ïa ka jingïalong lok bad ka jingïateh jutang jong ngi bad ki.
Ngi la bthah ïa ki ba kin leit ruh sha phi ban ai khublei ïa phi bad ban ai ïa kane ka shithi na ngi shaphang ka jingpynthymmai ïa ka jingïadei shipara jong ngi.
Te sngewbha phah jubab ïa ngi shaphang kane.”
Kane ka long ka nokol jong kata ka shithi kaba ki la phah sha u Onias:
“U Arius, u syiem ki Sparta, ha u Onias lyngdoh rangbah, ka jingkhublei.
La shem ha ki jynthoh jyntar ba ki Sparta bad ki Ju ki ïadei shipara bad ba ki dei na ka ïing ka sem jong u Abraham.
Te mynta ba ngi la tip shaphang kane, sngewbha thoh sha ngi shaphang kane ka jingshem bha shem miat jong phi;

ngi na ka liang jong ngi ngi thoh sha phi ba ki jynri jyndup bad ka spah ka hajar jong phi ka long ka jong ngi, bad ka jong ngi ka long ruh ka jong phi. Ngi namarkata ngi hukum ba ki nonglam ktien jong ngi kin ïathuh ïa phi kumta.”
Te u Jonathan u la ïohsngew ba ki rangbah shipai u Demetrius ki la wan phai lem bad ka kynhun shipai kaba kham heh ban ïa ka bamynshuwa, ban ïaleh thma ïa u.
Kumta u la ïaid bak bak na Jerusalem bad u la ïakynduh ïa ki ha ka thaiñ Hamath, namar um shym ailad ïa ki ban hiar thma ïa la ka ri.
U la phah ki nongsyntiat sha ka jaka dara jong ki, bad ynda ki la wan phai ki la ïathuh ha u ba u nongshun u la ïeng kynhun shriak ban tur pyrshah ïa ki Ju mynmiet.

Te haba ka sngi ka la sep, u Jonathan u la ai hukum ïa la ki briew ba kin ap mrong bad ban don la ki tiar thma hajan, khnang ban long kiba la kloi na ka bynta ka thma baroh shimiet, bad u la buh ki jaka ap baroh sawdong ka jaka dara.

Haba ki nongshun ki la ïohsngew ba u Jonathan bad ki briew jong u ki la pynkhreh na ka bynta ka thma, ki la sheptieng bad ki la sngewtriem ha ka mynsiem; kumta ki la sliew ding ha ka jaka dara jong ki bad ki la phet sor.
Hynrei u Jonathan bad ki briew jong u kim shym tip ïa kata tat ynda mynstep, namarba ki la ïohi ba meh ki ding.
Kumta u Jonathan u la beh ïa ki nadien, hynrei u khlem lap shuh ïa ki, namarba ki la lah kam ïa ka wah Eleutherus.
Kumta u Jonathan u la kdat lynti ban ïaleh ïa ki Arab ba la sin kyrteng Zabadean; u la jop ïa ki bad u la kurup ïa ki artat.
Nangta u la ieh noh ïa ka jaka dara bad u la leit sha Damaskus, bad u la ïaid lyngba kata ka thaiñ baroh.
U Simon ruh u la mih bad u la ïaid lyngba ka ri shaduh Askalon bad ki kut kiba don marjan marjan. U la kdat lynti sha Joppa bad u la knieh kyndit kyndit ïa ka,
namar u la bna wer wer ba ki la pynkhreh ban aiti ïa ka kut ha ki briew kiba u Demetrius u la phah. U la buh shi pyrton ki shipai ban ap ïa ka.
Haba u Jonathan u la wan phai, u lum ïa ki tymmen ki san jong u paidbah, bad u la ïasaiñ dur lang bad ki kumno ban tei ki kut ha Judea,

ban tei kham kynjang ïa ki kynroh ka Jerusalem, bad ban pynïeng ka jynker ka bakynjang hapdeng ka kut shnong bad ka nongbah ban pynkhlad ïa ka na ka shnong, khnang ban pynkyrpang ïa ka ha kata ka rukom ba ki pyrton jong ka kin ym lah ban ïa die ïa thied.
Kumta ki la ïalum lang ban tei ïa ka nongbah; shi bynta na ka kynroh kaba ha ka them shaphang mihngi ka la twa, bad u la maramot ïa ka bynta ba ki khot Khaphenatha.
U Simon u la tei ïa ka Adida kaba ha Shephela, u la pynkhlaiñ ïa ka da ki khyrdop bad ki nar khang.
Te u Tripho u la kwah eh ban kylla long u syiem ka Asia, ban phong pansngiat, bad ban thom ïa u syiem Antiokhus.
U la tieng ba u Jonathan un ym shah ïa u ban leh kumta, ïoh u ïaleh thma pynban ïa u, kumta u la ïai-wad ban ïoh kem bad ban pynïap ïa u; kumta u la mih bad u la poi ha Beth-shan.
U Jonathan u la leit ban ïaleh ïa u da ki ’riewkynsai sawphew hajar ngut, bad u la wan sha Beth-shan.
Haba u Tripho u la ïohi ba u la wan bad ka kynhun shipai ka baheh, u la sheptieng ban rah kti pyrshah ïa u.

Kumta u la pdiang ïa u da ka burom bad u la ïaroh ïa u ha ki lok jong u baroh; u la ai ïa u ki jynai sngewbha bad u la hukum ïa ki lok bad ki shipai jong u ban kohnguh ïa u Jonathan kumba ki kohnguh ïa u hi.
Te u la ong ha u Jonathan, “Balei sha phi pyndik ïa kine ki briew haba ym don thma don wait?

Phah noh ïa ki mynta sha la ïing la ïing bad pynsah bad phi tang khyndiat ngut ki briew kiba phi jied hi, nangta wan bad nga sha Ptolemais. Ngan aiti noh ïa ka ha phi bad kiwei pat ki kut, ïa ki shipai kiba dang sah bad ïa ki rangbah sorkar baroh, nangta nga ruh ngan phai noh ban leit sha ïing. Na kane ka daw nga sa don hangne.”
U Jonathan u la shaniah ïa u bad u la leh kumba u la ong; u la phah noh ïa ki shipai, bad ki la leit phai sha ri Judea.
U la bat bad u laihajar ngut, arhajar na kine u la ieh noh ha Galilea, bad shihajar ngut ki la bud ïa u.
Hynrei haba u Jonathan u la rung ha Ptolemais, ki nong Ptolemais ki la khang sbak ïa ki khyrdop bad ki la kem ïa u, bad ïa ki briew baroh kiba la rung bad u la pynïap da ka waitlam.
Markumta u Tripho u la phah shipai bad pyrton kulai sha Galilea bad sha ka Madan Bah ban pynïap duh ïa ki shipai jong u Jonathan.

Ynda ki la sngewthuh ba u Jonathan u la shah kem bad u la lah ïap ryngkat bad ki briew jong u, ki la ïapynshlur uwei ïa uwei pat bad ki la ïaid la ka ïaid syndah sbiak shikynhun, kum kiba la kloi ban ïaleh thma.
Haba ki nongbeh nadien ki la ïohi ba kine kin ïaleh dukhi dukhait, ki la phai dien.
Kumta ki la poi suk ha ri Judea, bad ki la ïam pangnud na ka bynta u Jonathan bad ki lok jong u, bad ki la tieng shibun; baroh shi Israel ki la ïam briew.

Kumta ki jait bynriew kiba don sawdong jong ki ki la pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ki, hana ki ong, “Kim don nongïalam ne nongïarap shuh. To mynta ngin ïaleh thma ïa ki ban pynduh pyndam noh khoit napdeng ki briew.”
U Simon u la ïohsngew ba u Tripho u la lum ka kynhun shipai ka baheh ban hiar thma ïa ka ri Judea bad ban pynjot ïa ka,
bad u la ïohi ba ki paidbah ki la khynñiuh da ka jingtieng. Kumta u la leit sha Jerusalem, bad ynda u la lum ïa ki paidbah baroh

u la pynshngaiñ ïa ki da kaba ong ha ki, “Ma phi phi tip katno kiei kiei ki bakhraw ma nga bad ki hynmen jong nga bad ka ïing u kpa jong nga ngi la leh na ka bynta ki aiñ bad ka tempyl; phi tip ruh ïa ki thma bad ki jingeh kiba ngi la ïohi.
Na kane ka daw baroh ki hynmen jong nga ki la ïap na ka bynta ki Israel, bad nga sah satang ma nga marwei.
Te mynta, da lei lei ruh em ngan ym tyngkai ïa la ka jingim ha kano kano ka por jinglanot, naba ngam long kham bha ban ïa ki hynmen jong nga.

Hynrei ngan sa pynhiar kput na ka bynta ka jait bynriew jong nga bad ka tempyl, na ka bynta ki tnga bad ki khun jong phi, naba ki jait bynriew baroh ki la ïalum lang da ka jingshun ban pynïap duh ïa ngi.”
Ki paidbah ki la ïoh mynsiem tang shu ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien,
bad ki la jubab da ka sur bajam, “Ma phi phi long u nongïalam jong ngi ha ka jaka u Judas bad u Jonathan u hynmen jong phi.
To ïalam ïa ki thma jong ngi, bad ngin leh kat kaba phi ong.”
Kumta u la lum lang ïa ki ’riewthma baroh bad u la leh kloi ban pyndep ïa ki kynroh ka Jerusalem, bad u la pynkhlaiñ ïa ka na ki dong baroh.
U la phah ïa u Jonathan, u khun jong u Absalom, sha Joppa lem bad ka kynhun shipai ka bakhraw; u Jonathan u beh krad ïa ki nongshong shnong jong ka bad u la sah hangta.
Te u Tripho u la mih na Ptolemais bad ka kynhun shipai kaban hiar thma ïa ka ri Judea, bad u la ïalam ïa u Jonathan bad u kum u koidi.
U Simon u la shong dara ha Adida, marpyrshah ka madan.
U Tripho u la tip ba u Simon u la mih ha ka jaka u Jonathan u hynmen jong u, bad ba un sa ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u, kumta u la phah ki nonglamktien sha u, u ong,
“Dei namar ka tyngka ba u Jonathan u hynmen jong phi u dei ban siew ha ka jynkynshew u syiem shaphang ki kam ba u la kit, ba ngi sa bat ïa u.
Lada phi phah mynta shispah talen ka rupa bad ar ngut na ki khun shynrang jong u kum ki koidi jamin, kumta ba ynda la pyllait ïa u un ym ïeng pyrshah shuh ïa ngi, bad ngin sa pyllait ïa u.”
U Simon u la tip ba ki la kren shukor ïa u, hynrei u phah la ka phah ïa ka tyngka bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u, ïoh mih ka jingpyn-eh ka bakhraw hapdeng ki paidbah , kiba lah ban ong,
“Dei na ka daw ba u Simon um shym phah ïa ka tyngka bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ba u sa ïap.”
Kumta u la phah ïa ki khun shynrang jong u bad ïa ki shispah talen, hynrei u Tripho u la pynkheiñ ïa la ka juban bad um shym pyllait ïa u Jonathan.

Hadien kane u Tripho u la wan ban hiar thma ïa ka ri bad ban pynjot ïa ka, bad u la ïaid tawiar sawdong na ka lynti sha Adora. Hynrei u Simon bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la ïai bud marpyrshah jong u kat shaba u leit.
Te ki briew kiba ha ka kut shnong ki la ïaiphah nonglamktien sha u Tripho da kaba kyntu ïa u ban wan sha ki na ri kynjah bad ban phah jynbam ïa ki.
Kumta u Tripho u la pynkhreh ba u pyrton kulai un leit, hynrei ha kata ka miet la hap jur ka ïor, bad um shym leit na ka daw jong kata ka ïor. U la leit noh bak bak shaduh Gilead.
Haba u la poi ha Baskama, u la pynïap ïa u Jonathan, bad u la tep ïa u hangta.
Nangta u Tripho u la phai dien bad u la leit noh sha la ka ri.
Te u Simon u la phah shim ïa ki shyieng u Jonathan u hynmen jong u, bad u la tep ïa u ha Modeiñ, ka nongbah jong ki kpa tymmen jong u.
Baroh shi Israel ki la ïam pangnud jur ïa u bad ki la leh sngewsih bun bun sngi na ka bynta jong u.
U Simon u la tei u mot halor ka jyntep jong u kpa bad jong ki hynmen jong u. U Simon u la tei u mot ba lah ban ïohi naduh jngai, u da pyndonkam da u maw pleit hakhmat bad hadien.
U la tei ruh hynñiew tylli ki piramid, kiba ïaphai marpyrshah, na ka bynta u kpa, ka kmie bad ki hynmen jong u sawngut.

Ïa ki piramid u la pyniphuh baroh sawdong da ki kynja mot mawbynna ki baheh, bad halor kine u la buh ïa ki riam thma ban long ka jynkynmaw burom kaba shi junom, bad ha syndah ki riam thma u la oh shrong da ki lieng, kumta ba lah ban ïohi ïa ki da kito baroh kiba shonglieng ha duriaw.
Kane ka long kata ka jyntep kaba u la tei ha Modeiñ; ka dang sah haduh mynta mynne.
U Tripho u la shet kylla ïa u khynnah syiem u Antiokhus; u la pynïap ïa u,
bad u la long syiem ha ka jaka jong u, u da phong artat ïa ka pansngiat jong ka Asia; u la wan rah ka jinglanot ka bakhraw ha ka ri.
Hynrei u Simon u la tei ki kut ha Judea bad u la ker kynroh ïa ki baroh sawdong, lem bad ki kut kynjang, ki kynroh jrong, ki khyrdop bad ki nar khang, bad u la kynshew jynbam ha ki kut.
U Simon u la jied ruh ki briew bad u la phah ïa ki sha u syiem Demetrius da kaba kyrpad ba un ai jingpyn-aram ïa ka ri, naba kat kaba u Tripho u la leh ka la long tang ban kurup.
U syiem Demetrius u la phah sha u ka jubab ka basbun ïa kane ka jingkyrpad, bad u la thoh shithi sha u kumne,
“U syiem Demetrius sha u Simon lyngdoh rangbah bad u lok jong ki syiem, bad sha ki tymmen ki san bad ka jait bynriew Ju, ka jingkhublei.
Ngi la ïoh pdiang ïa ka pansngiat ksiar bad ka tnat dieng tlai ba phi la phah, bad ngi la kloi ban ïasuk bad phi nadong shadong bad ban thoh sha ki rangbah syiem ba kin pyllait khajna ïa phi.
Baroh kiei kiei ba ngi la rai na ka bynta jong phi kin sah kumjuh, bad ki kut ba phi la tei kin neh ha ki kti jong phi.

Ngi map ïa kino kino ki jingbakla bad ki jingpynkheiñ ba la leh haduh kane ka sngi, bad ngi pynduh ïa ka bai khrong syiem ba phi dei ban siew. Ïa kano kano kawei pat ka jynkhrong ba la ju lum na Jerusalem yn ym lum shuh.
Lada don mano mano na phi uba tbit ban rung kam ha ka kynhun ki shipai syiem, to kin rung, te kumta ai ba yn don ka jingsuk jingsaiñ hapdeng jong ngi.”
Ha ka snem 170 [142 SK], ïa ka lyngkor jong ki Jentil la weng noh na Israel,
bad ki paidbah ki la sdang ban thoh ha ki dulir bad ki dostabit, “Ha ka snem ka banyngkong jong u Simon u lyngdoh rangbah u bakhraw bad u rangbah thma bad u nongïalam jong ki Ju.”

Ha kito ki sngi u Simon u la shong dara ha pyrshah Gasara bad u la ker tawiar ïa ka da ki shipai: U la thaw kawei ka kor kerkut, u la wan rah ïa ka sha kata ka nongbah, u la ther da ka bad u la ïoh knieh kawei ka kut kynjang.
Ki briew kiba na ka kor kerkut ki la ryngkoh hapoh shnong, bad la khie tik ka jingkhynwin hapoh kata ka nongbah.
Ki briew kata ka shnong, ryngkat bad la ki tnga bad ki khun rit, ki la leit kiew ïa ka kynroh bad ki jaiñ kiba la kad, bad ki la kyang da ka sur ka bajam, ki kyrpad ïa u Simon ban ïasuk noh bad ki;
ki la ong, “Wat leh ïa ngi katkum ki kam dakaid jong ngi hynrei katkum ka jingisynei jong phi.”

Kumta u Simon u la ïateh kular bad ki bad u la sangeh ban ïaleh ïa ki. Hynrei u la beh noh ïa ki napoh kata ka shnong, u la pynkhuid ïa ki ïing ha kiba la don ki blei thaw, nangta u la rung hapoh jong ka da ki jingrwai ïaroh.

U la bret shabar jong ka ïa ka kynja jingbymkhuid baroh, bad u la pynshong ha ka da ki briew kiba la rakhe ïa ka aiñ. U la pynkhlaiñ ruh ïa ki kut jong ka bad u la tei hangta kawei ka ïing na ka bynta ïa lade.
Ïa ki briew ha ka kut shnong kaba ha Jerusalem la khanglad ban mih shabar, ban leit sha nongkyndong bad wan phai ban die ban thied. Kumta ki la thngan, bad bunbah ki la ïap thngan.
Te kumta ki la kyrpad ïa u Simon ban ïasuk bad ki, u ruh u la leh kumta. Hynrei u la beh noh ïa ki nangta bad u la pynkhuid ïa ka jakhlia jakhlaid na kata ka kut shnong.

Ha ka sngi ka ba-arphew lai jong u bnai u ba-ar, ha ka snem 171 [141 SK], ki Ju ki la rung ha ka da ki jingrisa bad ki tnat dieng tlai, da ki duitara, ki ’singrit bad ki jyntemksai, da ki jingrwai bad ki jingïaroh, namarba la ïuh roit ïa u nongshun u bakhraw bad la weng artat ïa u na Israel.

Te u Simon u la rai ba man la ka snem ki dei ban leh burom ïa kane ka sngi da ka jingleh kmen. U la pynkhlaiñ ïa ki kut jong u lum tempyl marsyndah syndah ka kut shnong, bad ma u bad ki briew jong u ki la shong hangta.
U Simon u la ïohi ba u Ïoannis u khun jong u u la rangbah, kumta u la thung rangbah shipai ïa u halor ki pyrton thma baroh, bad une u la shong ha Gasara.
Ha ka snem 172 [140 SK], u syiem Demetrius u la lum lang ïa ki pyrton thma jong u bad u la leit shaduh Media ban ïoh jingïarap, khnang ba un dup ïaleh thma ïa u Tripho.
Haba u Arsases, u syiem Persha bad Media, u la ïohsngew ba u Demetrius u la hiar thma ïa ka ri jong u, u la phah uwei na ki rangbah pyrton jong u ban kem im ïa u.
Te une u la leit bad u la ïoh kem ïa u bad u la rah ïa u sha u Arsases, uba la buh ïa u hapoh byndi.
Ka ri ka la shongsuk katba dang im u Simon. U la wad ïa ka jingbha ka jait bynriew jong u; ka jingsynshar jong u ka pynsngewbha ïa ki, kumjuh ruh ka jingkhraw burom jong u, katba u dang im.
Kum ka pansngiat jong ka burom jong u u la jop ïa ka kadlieng Joppa, u la plie lynti sha ki dewlynnong jong ka duriaw.
U la pynïar ïa ki pud jong ka ri lajong, u la ïoh ban synshar ïa ka ri baroh kawei.

U la pynphai biang sha la ka ri byllien bah ki koidi; u la long kynrad halor ka Gasara, ka Beth-Zur bad ka kut shnong, bad u la pynkhuid na ka ïa ka kynja jingjakhlia baroh; ym don ba lah ban ïeng pyn-eh ïa u.
Ki la rep la riang ïa ka khyndew ha ka jingsuk; ka khyndew ka la pynmih soh kyrhai, bad ki dieng ha ri thor ki la seisoh.
Ki ’riewtymmen ki la shong sadhai ha ki lynti shnong; ki ïasaid thma sahuh ïa ka jingmanbha manmiat; sa ki samla ki ïariam da ki jaiñ thma ki baphyrnai.
U la pynbiang ka bam ka dih ïa ki shnong ki thaw, u la taïar ki tiar ïaleh thma haban da pura, haduh ba ka nam jong u ka la phriang sha bakut ka pyrthei.
U la pynskhem ïa ka jingsuk ha ka ri, ki Israel ki la dap miar da ka jingkmen ka bakhraw.
Man la u briew u la shong hapoh la u diengsoh waiñ bad u diengsoh dymbur, bad ym don mano mano ban pynsheptieng ïa ki.
Ym shym sah shuh mano mano ha ka ri ban ïaleh ïa ki, bad ïa ki syiem la ïuh roit ha kito ki sngi.
U la pynkhlaiñ ïa ki barit baria jong u paidbah jong u; u la ïaleh ban rakhe ïa ka aiñ, kumta u la weng noh ïa u kynja ’riewbe-aiñ bad ïa u kynja ’riewdakaid baroh.
U la pynphyrnai ïa ka tempyl, bad u la pyndap ïa ka da ki khiew ki pliang ki bathymmai.
La ïohsngew ha Rome, wat shaduh Sparta, ba u Jonathan u la ïap, bad ki la diaw shibun eh.
Haba ki la ïohsngew ba u Simon u para jong u u la long u lyngdoh rangbah ha ka jaka jong u, bad ba u la synshar halor ka ri bad ki shnong jong ka,
ki la thoh sha u ha ki lyngkniap rnong ban pynthymmai ïa la ka jingïalong lok bad ka soskular kaba ki la pynskhem bad u Judas bad u Jonathan ki hynmen jong u.
Ïa kine la pule hakhmat ka jingïakynduh paidbah ha Jerusalem.

Kane ka long ka nokol jong kata ka shithi ba ki Sparta ki la phah: “Ki nongsynshar bad ka nongbah jong ki Sparta sha u Simon lyngdoh rangbah, sha ki tymmen ki san bad ki lyngdoh bad sha ki paidbah Ju baroh lin, ka jingkhublei.
Ki nonglamktien ïa kiba la phah sha ki briew jong ngi ki la ïathuh ha ngi shaphang ka nam bakhraw jong phi, bad ngi la shadkmen ba ki la wan.

Te ïa kata kaba ki la ïathuh, ngi la buh jingkynmaw ha ki rai hima sima jong ngi, kumne, ‘U Numenius, u khun u Antiokhus, bad u Antipater, u khun u Jason, ki nonglamktien na ki Ju, ki la wan sha ngi ban pynthymmai ïa ka jinglong lok jong ki bad ngi.

Ki paidbah jong ngi ki la sngewbha ban pdiang burom ïa kine ki briew bad ban buh jynthoh ïa ki ktien jong ki ha ki ïingbuh dulir hima, khnang ba ki paidbah Sparta kin dup don ka jingkynmaw ïa ki. Te kumta ki la phah kawei ka nokol jong kane sha u Simon lyngdoh rangbah.’ ”
Hadien kane u Simon u la phah ïa u Numenius sha Rome bad ka stieh ksiar ka baheh kaba khia shihajar mina, ban pynskhem ïa ka soskular bad ki Roman.
Haba ki briew ki la ïohsngew ïa kine kiei kiei ki la ong, “Kumno keiñ ngin ainguh ïa u Simon bad ïa ki khun jong u?
Naba ma u bad ki hynmen jong u bad ka ïing u kpa jong u ki la ïeng skhem; ki la ïaleh bad ki la jop thiaw ïa ki nongshun jong ka Israel bad ki la pynskhem ïa la ka jinglaitluid.”

Kumta ki la thoh kynmaw ïa kata ha ki lyngkniap rnong, bad ki la buh ïa ka halor ki païa kiba ha lum Zion. Kane ka long ka nokol jong kata kaba ki la thoh: “Ha ka sngi ka bakhatphra jong u ’nai Elul, ha ka snem 172 [140 SK], kaba la long ka snem balai jong u Simon u lyngdoh rangbah u bakhraw,
hapoh Asaramel, ha ka jingïakynduh paidbah jong ki lyngdoh, ki paidbah, ki bakhraw batri jong ka jait bynriew bad ki tymmen ki san jong ka ri, ïa kane harum la pynbna ha ngi: —

“Mynba la don shibun ki thma hapoh ka ri, u Simon, khun jong u Matathias lyngdoh uba na ki khun shynrang jong u Joarib, lem bad ki hynmen para jong u, ki la pha ïa lade ha ki jingma bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong ka jait bynriew jong ki, khnang ba yn dup ïada ïa ka tempyl bad ïa ka aiñ jong ki; te ki la wan rah ka burom ka bakhraw halor ka jait bynriew jong ki.
U Jonathan u la pyntylli lang ïa ka jait bynriew, u la kylla long u lyngdoh rangbah jong ki, bad la tep lang ïa u bad la ki kpa tymmen.
Te haba ki nongshun jong ki ki la thew ban hiar thma ïa ka ri jong ki bad ki la ktah kti ïa ka tempyl jong ki,
hangta u Simon u la khie ir bad u la ïaleh na ka bynta ka jait bynriew lajong. U la pynlut shibun bah ka tyngka lajong; u la ai tiar thma ïa ki pyrton jong ka ri lajong bad u la siew tulop ïa ki.
U la pynkhlaiñ ïa ki shnong Judea, bad ïa ka Beth-Zur kaba ha khap-pud Judea, ha kaba ki nongshun ki la ju kynshew tiar thma mynshuwa, bad u la buh kawei ka karod ki pyrton Ju hangta.

U la tei pynkhlaiñ ruh ïa ka Joppa, kaba don harud duriaw, bad ïa ka Gasara, kaba ha khap-pud Azotus, ha kaba la shong mynshuwa u nongshun. U la pynshong hangne ïa ki Ju, bad u la pynbiang katba donkam ban maramot ïa kito ki nongbah.

“Ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa ka jingngeit jong u Simon bad ïa ka burom kaba u la kut jingmut ban pynïoh na ka bynta ka jait bynriew jong u. Ki la pynlong ïa u u nongïalam bad u lyngdoh rangbah jong ki, namarba u la leh ïa kine kiei kiei, bad namarba u la pyn-neh ïa ka hok bad ka jingieid ïa la ka jait bynriew. U la wad lad har rukom ban kyntiew ïa la ki briew.

Ha ki sngi jong u, kiei kiei ki la manbha ha ki kti jong u, haduh ba ïa ki Jentil la jynrat na ka ri, kumjuh ruh ïa ki briew kiba ha ka Nongbah u Dabid, ha Jerusalem, kiba la tei ka kut shnong na kaba ki shait wan tur kynsan bad ki pynbyrsieh ïa ki shakiar jong ka tempyl, bad ki leh sang ïa ka jingkhuid jong ka.
U la pynshong ïa ki Ju hangta hapoh jong ka, bad u la pynkhlaiñ ïa ka ba yn lait jingma ïa ka ri bad ïa ka nongbah, bad u la tei pynkynjang ruh ïa ki kynroh ka Jerusalem.
“Na ka daw jong kine kiei kiei u syiem Demetrius u la pynskhem ïa u ha ka jinglong lyndoh rangbah,
bad u la pynlong ïa u uwei na ki lok jong u syiem bad u la ai burom shibun ïa u.
U la ïohsngew ba ki Roman ki la khot ïa ki Ju ki lok, ki lok ïateh soskular bad ki hynmen para, bad ba ki Roman ki la pdiang burom ïa ki nonglamktien jong u Simon.
“Te ki Ju bad ki lyngdoh jong ki ki la rai ba u Simon u dei ban long u nongïalam bad u lyngdoh rangbah jong ki shi junom, haduh ba yn da mih u nongïathuhlypa uba ki shaniah,

bad ba u dei ban long u kynja nongsynshar jong ki bad ba u dei ban peit ïa ka tempyl, ban thung ki briew halor ki kam ki jam, halor ka ri, halor ki tiar thma bad halor ki kut bad ba un kit khlieh artat ban sumar ïa ka tempyl,
bad kumta ba ki briew baroh ki dei ban kohnguh ïa u, bad ba ïa ki jingïateh juban baroh ha ka ri dei ban thoh ha ka kyrteng jong u, bad ba u dei ban riam da ka banat saw bad un deng da ka ksiar.

“Yn ym shah ba kino kino ki ’riewpaidbah ne ki lyngdoh kin pynduh ïa kano kano na kine ki rai ne ban pyrshah ïa kata kaba u ong, ne ban lum kynja jingïakynduh hapoh ka ri khlem da shah ma u, ne ba kin riam da ka banat saw ne kin deng panpoh ksiar.
Kat uba leh pyrshah ïa kine ki rai ne pynduh ïa kano kano na kine u dei ban shah saja.”
Te ki paidbah baroh ki la ïamynjur ban ai ha u Simon ïa ka hok ban leh katkum kine ki rai.
Kumta u Simon u la pdiang bad u la kohnguh ban long u lyngdoh rangbah, ban long u rangbah duh jong ki pyrton bad u Ethnark jong ki Ju bad ki lyngdoh, bad ban long u nongïada jong ki baroh.
Te ki la pynmih hukum ban thoh ïa kane ka rai ha ki lyngkniap rnong, ban buh ïa ki ha ka jaka ka bashynna ha ka jaka ba la ker jong ka tempyl,
bad ban buh nokol ïa kine ha ka jaka jynkynshew khnang ba u Simon bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin dup ïoh ïa ki.
Te u Antiokhus, u khun u syiem Demetrius, u la phah shithi na ki dewlynnong ka duriaw sha u Simon, u lyngdoh bad u Ethnark jong ki Ju, bad sha ka jait bynriew baroh kawei.
Kata ka jynthoh ka long kumne harum: “U syiem Antiokhus ha u Simon u lyngdoh rangbah bad u Ethnark bad ha ka jait bynriew Ju, ka jingkhublei.

Namarba katto katne ngut ki ’riewpohrati ki la leh trai khlieh ïa ka hima ki kpa tymmen jong ngi, nga thmu ban dawa noh ïa kata ka hima khnang ba ngan dup ïoh ban pynskhem biang ïa ka kumba ka la long mynshuwa, bad namarba nga la khot bylla shibun bah ki shipai nongwei bad nga la taïar ki lieng ïapom,

bad namarba nga mut ban ïuhkjat ha kata ka ri khnang ba ngan dup lah ban leit tur pyrshah kito kiba la pynjot ïa ka ri jong ngi bad kiba la pynlko pom ïa ki bun bah ki shnong ki thaw ha ka hima jong nga,

nga pynskhem ïa phi mynta namarkata ba phin lait siew ïa ki khajan baroh na kiba ki syiem kiba ha shuwa jong nga ki la pyllait ïa phi, bad nga weng noh ïa ki jynsiew baroh na kiba kita ki la pyllait ïa phi.
Nga shah ïa phi ban thaw la ka jong ka pisa tyngka na ka bynta ka ri jong phi,
bad nga ai jinglaitluid ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ka tempyl. Baroh ki tiar thma ba phi la pynkhreh bad ki kut ba phi la tei bad phi bat mynta, kin sah ki jong phi.
Ïa ka kynja ram baroh ba phi dei ban siew ha ka jynkynshew u syiem bad ïa kino kino ki ram kiba kum kita hadien habud la pynduh noh na ka bynta jong phi naduh mynta bad junom.

Ynda ngi ïoh synshar ïa la ka hima, ngin sa ai ka burom ka bakhraw halor jong phi bad ka jait bynriew jong phi bad ka tempyl jong phi, kumta ba ka burom jong phi kan phuh kyndiang ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei.”
Ha ka snem 174 [138 SK] u Antiokhus u la mih bad u la hiar thma ïa ka ri jong ki kpa tymmen jong u. Baroh ki shipai ki la ïeng tylli lang bad u, haduh ba satang khyndiat ngut ki la sah bad u Tripho.
U Antiokhus u la bud ïa u nadien bad une u la her ïap shaduh Dora, kaba don harud duriaw,
namar u la ithuh ba ki jingjynjar baroh ki la hap lynshop lut ha u, bad ba ki shipai jong u ki la ieh noh noh ïa u.
Kumta u Antiokhus u la shongdara marpyrshah ka Dora, bad la don ryngkat bad u shispah arphew hajar ki khla ka wait bad phra hajar ki pyrton kulai.
U la kerkut ïa kata ka nongbah, bad ki lieng ïapom ki la tur ban ïaleh na duriaw; u la khem riap riap ïa kata ka nongbah na ryngkew bad na duriaw, bad um shah ïano ïano ban mih ne ban rung ha ka.
Te u Numenius bad ki lok jong u ki la wan phai na Rome, bad ki shithi sha ki syiem bad ki ri, bad ha kita la thoh kumne:
“U Lusius, u konsul ki Roman, ha u syiem Ptolemi, ka jingkhublei.

Ki nonglamktien jong ki Ju ki la wan sha ngi kum ki lok bad ki nongïateh soskular bad ngi, ban pynthymmai ïa ka jingïalong lok bad ka jingïateh soskular jong ngi. Ïa ki la phah da u Simon u lyngdoh rangbah bad da ki paidbah Ju,
bad ki la wan rah ka stieh ksiar kaba khia shihajar mina.

Ngi la rai namarkata ban thoh sha ki syiem bad ki ri ba kim dei ban wad jingsniew ei ei ïa ki ne ban ïaleh thma ïa ki, ïa ki shnong jong ki bad ïa ka ri jong ki, ne ban ïateh soskular bad kito kiba ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki.
Te ka la idei ha ngi ban pdiang ïa kata ka stieh na ki.
Namarkata lada kino kino ki ’riewpohrati ki wan phet sha phi na ka ri jong ki, to aiti ïa ki ha u Simon lyngdoh rangbah, ba un dup pynsaja ïa ki katkum ka aiñ.”
U konsul u la thoh ïa kane kajuh ka shithi sha u syiem Demetrius, sha u Attalus, u Ariarathes bad u Arsases,

bad sha ki ri baroh—sha Sampsames, sha Sparta, sha Delos, sha Mindos, sha Sision, sha Karia, sha Samos, sha Pamphilia, sha Lisia, sha Halikarnassus, sha Rhodes, sha Phaselis, sha Kos, sha Side, sha Aradus bad Gortin, sha Knidus, sha Siprus bad sha Sirene.
Ki la phah ruh ïa ka nokol jong kine ki shithi sha u Simon lyngdoh rangbah.

U syiem Antiokhus u la kerkut ïa ka Dora sa shiwat, u la phah tur lynter ïa la ki shipai pyrshah ïa ka bad da ki kor thma ba u la phah thaw; u la khangdong ïa u Tripho bad ym don shuh ba lait ban rung ne ban mih.
Te u Simon u la phah sha u Antiokhus arhajar ngut ki ’riewkynsai ban ïaleh na ka bynta jong u, lem bad ka rupa, ka ksiar bad shibun ki tiar thma.
Hynrei une um treh pdiang ïa ki, bad u la pynkheiñ ïa ki jingïakut baroh kiba u la ïateh mynshuwa bad u Simon, kumta u la leh jngai na u.

U la phah sha u ïa u Athenobius, uwei na ki lok jong u, ban ïakren bad u, u ong, “Phi leh trai khlieh ïa ka Joppa bad ka Gasara bad ïa ka kut shnong ha Jerusalem; kine ki dei ki nongbah jong ka hima jong nga ei.
Phi la pynlko pom ïa ka ri jong ki, phi la pynjot thiaw ïa ka kyndew jong ki, bad phi la knieh ei bun ki jaka ha ka hima jong nga.
Te mynta to pynphai noh ïa ki nongbah ba phi la knieh bad ïa ka bai khajna na ki jaka ba phi la jop shabar ki pud ka Judea.

Lane shu ai noh na ka bynta kine sanspah talen ka rupa, bad na ka bynta ka jingpynjot ba phi la leh bad ka bai khajna na kita ki nongbah sa sanspah talen. Lymda kumta ngin sa wan ban ïaleh ïa phi da ka thma.”

Kumta u Athenobius u lok jong u syiem u la wan sha Jerusalem, bad haba u la ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw burom u Simon, bad ïa ka duli buhtiar ba ka don ki pliang ksiar pliang rupa, u la lyngngoh ngaiñ. U la ïathuh ha u ïa ki ktien jong u syiem,

hynrei u Simon u la ai ha u kane ka jubab, “Ngim shym knieh khyndew nongwei ne spah hajar nongwei, hynrei tang ïa la ka nongpateng ki kpa tymmen jong ngi, ïa kiba, ha ka por mynshuwa ki nongshun jong ngi ki la knieh bymhok na ngi.
Te mynta ba ngi la ïoh ïa ka kabu, ngi bat skhem ïa la ka nongpateng jong ki kpa tymmen lajong.

Shaphang ka Joppa, bad ka Gasara, kiba phi dawa, kine ki la pynjulor shibun eh ïa ki briew jong ngi bad ïa ka ri jong ngi; na ka bynta jong ki ngi dei ban ïoh shispah talen.” U Athenobius um shym jubab ïa u wat shikyntien,
hynrei u la leit phai da ka jingbitar sha u syiem bad u la ïathuh ha u ïa kine ki ktien, ïa ka jingkhraw burom jong u Simon bad ïa kata baroh kaba u la ïohi. U syiem te u la khie bitar lep.
Te u Tripho u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la phet sha Orthosia.
U syiem u la thung ïa u Sendebeus ban long u rangbah duh jong ki pyrton kiba ha ka ri khap duriaw, bad u la ai ha u ki shipai kjat bad ki pyrton kulai.

U la hukum ïa u ban shong dara marpyrshah ka Judea, bad u la bthah ban tei pynkhlaiñ ïa ka Kedron bad ïa ki khyrdop jong ka, bad ban ïaleh thma ïa ki briew, katba u syiem pat de u la beh nadien ïa u Tripho.
Kumta u Sendebeus u la wan tur sha Jamnia bad u la sdang ban pynsatia ïa ki paidbah bad ban hiar thma ïa ka Judea, da kaba kem koidi ïa ki briew bad da kaba pynïap ïa ki.
U la tei pynkhlaiñ ïa ka Kedron bad u la buh hangta ki pyrton kulai bad ki shipai, khnang ba kin ïoh leit ban hiar kurup ha ki lynti bah jong ka Judea, kumba u syiem u la hukum ïa u.
U Ïoannis u la leit kiew na Gasara bad u la ïathuh ha u Simon u kpa jong u ïa ka jingleh u Sendebeus.

Kumta u Simon u la khot ïa ki khun rangbah jong u ar ngut, u Judas bad u Ïoannis, bad u la ong ha ki: “Ma nga bad ki hynmen jong nga, bad ka ïing ka sem u kpa jong nga, ngi la ïaleh ïa ki thma ka Israel naduh ba ngi dang samla haduh kane ka sngi, bad kiei kiei ki la man bha ha ki kti jong ngi haduh ba ngi da ïoh ban pyllait ïa ka Israel bun wat.

Hynrei mynta nga la tymmen, ma phi pat da ka jingisynei jong u Blei phi la rangbah ha ka ryta. To shim ïa ka jaka jong nga bad ïa ka jong u hynmen jong nga, bad khie leit ïaleh na ka bynta ka jait bynriew lajong; to ka jingïarap kaba wan na Bneng kan don ryngkat bad phi.”
Kumta u Ïoannis u la jied na ka ri arphew hajar ki ’riewthma bad ki pyrton kulai, bad ki la leit tur pyrshah ïa u Sendebeus bad ki la shong dara shimiet ha Modeiñ.

Dang step phyrngap ki la khie bad ki la ïaid shaduh sha ri madan, bad hakhmih, ka kynhun ka baheh jong ki shipai kjat bad ki pyrton kulai ka la wan tur sha ki; bad hapdeng jong ki la don iwei i wahduid.

Te ma u bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la ïeng riang pyrshah ïa ki. Pynban u la ïohi ba ki shipai ki la leh tieng ban kam ïa kata ka wahduid, kumta ma u u la kam nyngkong; haba ki la ïohi ïa u, ma ki ruh ki la ïakam sha shiliang hadien jong u.
Te u la phiah ïa ka kynhun shipai ar liang bad u la buh ïa ki pyrton kulai hapdeng jong ki shipai kjat, namarba ki pyrton kulai jong ki nongshun ki la long ki babun.
Te ki la put ïa ki turoi, bad u Sendebeus bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la her ïap, bad bun bah na ki ki la mynsaw bad ki la kyllon; kiwei pat ki la phet sha ka kut.
Ha kata ka por u Judas, u hynmen jong u Ïoannis, u la mynsaw, hynrei u Ïoannis u la beh ïa ki nadien haduh ba u Sendebeus u la poi ha Kedron kaba u la tei.

Ki la phet sa nangta shaduh ki kut kynjang kiba la don ha ki lum ki wah jong ka Asotus, bad u Ïoannis u la thang ïa ka da ka ding, bad antad ar hajar ngut na ki ki la kyllon. Une te u la wan phai suk sha Judea.
Te la jia ba ïa u Ptolemi, u khun jong u Abubus, la thung u lat jong ka ri thor Jerikho, bad u la don shibun ka rupa bad ka ksiar,
namarba u la long u pyrsa kurim jong u lyngdoh rangbah.
U la sngewmeng ha ka dohnud; u la rai kut ban ïoh leh trai khlieh ïa ka ri, bad u la thaw ki buit shet kylla pyrshah ïa u Simon bad ki khun shynrang jong u, ban pynïap ïa ki.

Ka la jia ba u Simon u dang leit jngoh ïa ki shnong jong ka ri ban pynbeit ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki, bad u la leit sha Jerikho ryngkat bad u Matathias bad u Judas ki khun jong u, ha ka snem 177 [134 SK], ha u bnai u bakhatwei, uba dei u ’nai Shebat.
U khun jong u Abubus u la pdiang ïa ki da ka jingshetkylla ha ka kut rit kaba kyrteng ka Dok, kaba u la tei ma u; u la ai ïa ki ka jingkhawai ka bakhraw, bad u la buhriew ki briew hangta.

Haba u Simon bad ki khun jong u ki la dih bha, u Ptolemi bad ki briew jong u ki la ïeng kynsan, ki la shim ïa ki tiar thma, bad ki la tynrah ïa u Simon ha kata ka kamra jingkhawai ka baheh, bad ki la pynïap ïa u, ïa ki khun jong u ar ngut bad katto katne ngut na ki nongbud jong u.
Kumta u la leh ka kam shetkylla ka bakhraw, da kaba siew kylliang ïa ka jingbha da ka jingsniew.

Te kumta u Ptolemi u la thoh ka jingpyntip shaphang kine kiei kiei bad u la phah ïa kata sha u syiem, da kaba kyrpad artat ïa u ban phah shipai ban ïarap ïa u, bad nangta ban pynphai kylla ha u ïa ki nongbah bad ïa ka ilaka.

U la phah sa kiwei pat ki briew sha Gasara ban pynïap sa ïa u Ïoannis; u la phah ki shithi sha ki kapten da kaba kyrpad ïa ki ban wan sha u khnang ba un dup ai ïa ki ka rupa, ka ksiar bad kiwei ki jynai sngewbha;
u la phah sa kiwei shuh ki briew ban knieh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa u lum tempyl.
Hynrei la don kiba la wan mareh bak bak shakhmat bad ki la ïathuh ha u Ïoannis uba la don ha Gasara ba u kpa bad ki para jong u ki la ïap, bad ba u la “phah ki briew ban pynïap sa ïa phi ruh.”
U tang shu ïohsngew ïa kane, u la shaïong ngaiñ; te u la kem ïa kita ki briew kiba la wan ban pynïap ïa u bad u la pynïap ïa ki, naba u la sngewthuh ba ki la wan wad ban pynïap ïa u.
Ïa kiwei pat ki kam jong u Ïoannis, ïa ki thma jong u bad ïa ki kam shlur ba u la leh, ïa ka jingtei jong u ïa ki kynroh bad ïa ki jingleh ki bakhraw jong u—
la thoh ïa kine ha ki jynthoh kynmaw shaphang ka jinglong lyngdoh rangbah jong u, naduh ka por ba u la long lyngdoh rangbah hadien u kpa jong u.
